a: Meshammeshet veraata nidda — enah tzericha tevila, aval baal keri gereda — mechayyayv. la tema "mevarech", ella mehareher.

Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hirhur? vehatanya: baal keri sheen lo mayim litbol — kore keriat shema, veeno mevarech, lo lefaneha velo leachareha. veochel pitto umevarech leachareha, veeno mevarech lefaneha. aval mehareher belibbo veeno motzi bisfatav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach motzi bisfatav.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: asaan rabbi yehuda kehilchot derech eretz.
Detanya: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha", uchetiv batreh "yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elohecha bechorev", ma lehallan beema uveyira uvirtet uvezia, af kan beema uveyira uvirtet uvezia.
Mikkan amru: hazzavim vehametzoraim uvain al niddot — muttarim likrot battora uvanneviim uvakketuvim, lishnot bammishna ugemara uvahalachot uvaaggadot. aval baale kerayin asurim.

Rabbi yose omer: shone hu bargiliyyot, uvilvad shello yatztzia et hammishna. rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer: matztzia hu et hammishna, veeno matztzia et haggemara. rabbi natan ben avishalom omer: af matztzia et haggemara, uvilvad shello yomar azkarot shebbo. rabbi yochanan hassandelar talmido shel rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi akiva omer: lo yikkanes lammidrash kol ikkar. veamri la: lo yikkanes levet hammidrash kol ikkar. rabbi yehuda omer: shone hu behilchot derech eretz.

Maase berabbi yehuda sheraa keri, vehaya mehallech al gav hannahar. amru lo talmidav: rabbenu, shene lanu perek echad behilchot derech eretz. yarad vetaval veshana lahem. amru lo: lo kach limmadtanu rabbenu, shone hu behilchot derech eretz?! amar lahem: af al pi shemmekel ani al acherim, machmir ani al atzmi.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda ben betera haya omer: en divre tora mekabbelin tumea. maase betalmid echad shehaya megamgem lemala merabbi yehuda ben betera. amar leh: beni, petach picha veyairu devarecha, sheen divre tora mekabbelin tumea, shenneemar: "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai", ma esh eno mekabbel tumea af divre tora enan mekabbelin tumea.

Amar mar. matztzia et hammishna veeno matztzia et haggemara. mesayyay leh lerabbi ilay, deamar rabbi ilay amar rabbi acha bar yaakov mishshum rabbenu: halacha, matztzia et hammishna veeno matztzia et haggemara. ketannae: matztzia et hammishna veeno matztzia et haggemara, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel: ze vaze asur. veamri la: ze vaze muttar.
Man deamar ze vaze asur — kerabbi yochanan hassandelar, man deamar ze vaze muttar — kerabbi yehuda ben betera.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: nehug alma kehane telat save — kerabbi ilay bereshit haggez, kerabbi yoshiyya bechilayim, kerabbi yehuda ben betera bedivre tora.
Kerabbi ilay bereshit haggez — detanya, rabbi ilay omer: reshit haggez eno noheg ella baaretz.
Kerabbi yoshiyya bechilayim, kedichtiv: "lo tizra karmecha kilayim", rabbi yoshiyya omer: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyizra chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad.
Kerabbi yehuda ben betera bedivre tora, detanya, rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: en divre tora mekabbelin tumea.

Ki ata zeeri, amar: batteluha litviluta. veamri la: batteluha lintiluta. man deamar batteluha litviluta — kerabbi yehuda ben betera. man deamar batteluha lintiluta — ki ha derav chisda layet amman dimhaddar ammayya beiddan tzelota.

Tanu rabbanan: baal keri shennatnu alav tisha kabbin mayim — tahor. nachum ish gam zo lechashah lerabbi akiva, verabbi akiva lechashah leven azzay, uven azzay yatza ushenaah letalmidav beshuk. peligi ba tere amorae bemareva, rabbi yose bar avin verabbi yose bar zevida. chad tane: shenaah, vechad tane: lechashah.
Man detane shenaah, mishshum bittul tora umishshum bittul periyya ureviyya. uman detane lechashah — shello yehu talmide chachamim metzuyim etzel neshotehem ketarnegolim.
Amar rabbi yannay: shamati shemmekillin bah veshamati shemmachamirin bah, vechol hammachamir bah al atzmo maarichin lo yamav ushenotav.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ma tivan shel tovle shecharin? ma tivan?! ha ihu deamar baal keri asur bedivre tora. hachi kaamar: ma tivan bearbaim sea, efshar betisha kabbin. ma tivan bitvila, efshar bintina.
Amar rabbi chanina: gader gadol gadru bah. detanya: maase beechad shettava ishsha lidvar avera. amra lo: reka! yesh lecha arbaim sea sheatta tovel bahen? miyyad perash.
Amar lehu rav huna lerabbanan: rabbotay, mippene ma attem mezalzelin bitvila zo: i mishshum tzinna, efshar bemerchatzaot.
Amar leh rav chisda: vechi yesh tevila bechammin? amar leh: rav adda bar ahava kae kevotach.

Rabbi zera hava yatev beaggana demayya be massuta, amar leh leshammaeh: zil veayyti li tisha kabbin ushedi illavay. amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba: lema leh lemar kulle hay? veha yatev begavvavyyhu! amar leh: kearbaim sea, ma arbaim sea, bitvila velo bintina — af tisha kabbin bintina velo bitvila.
Rav nachman takken chatzba bat tisha kabbin. ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi akiva verabbi yehuda gelostera amru: lo shanu ella lechole leonso. aval lechole hammargil, arbaim sea.
Amar rav yosef: ittevar chatzbeh derav nachman. ki ata ravin amar beusha hava ovada
b: Bekila derav oshaya, ato usheilu lerav assi. amar lehu: lo shanu ella lechole hammargil, aval lechole leonso patur mikkelum. amar rav yosef: itztemid chatzbeh derav nachman.
Mikkede kullehu amorae vetannae bidezra kamippalgi, venechze ezra hechi takken.

Amar abbaye: ezra takken levari hammargil arbaim sea, uvari leonso tisha kabbin. vaato amorae ufeligi bechole. mar savar chole hammargil kevari hammargil vechole leonso kevari leonso. umar savar chole hammargil kevari leonso, vechole leonso patur mikkelum.

Amar rava: nehi detakken ezra tevila, netina mi takken?! vehaamar mar ezra tikken tevila levaale kerayin. ella amar rava: ezra takken tevila levari hammargil arbaim sea. vaato rabbanan vehatekinu levari leonso tisha kabbin. vaato amorae veka mippalgi bechole, mar savar chole hammargil kevari hammargil, vechole leonso — kevari leonso, umar savar levari hammargil arbaim sea, vechole hammargil kevari leonso — tisha kabbin. aval lechole leonso patur mikkelum.
Amar rava hilcheta: bari hammargil vechole hammargil — arbaim sea. uvari leonso — tisha kabbin. aval lechole leonso — patur mikkelum.
Tanu rabbanan: baal keri shennatnu alav tisha kabbin mayim — tahor. bamme devarim amurim — leatzmo, aval laacherim arbaim sea. rabbi yehuda omer: arbaim sea mikkol makom.

Rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi verabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina. chad mehay zuga vechad mehay zuga aresha, chad amar: ha deamrat bamme devarim amurim leatzmo, aval laacherim arbaim sea, lo shanu ella lechole hammargil, aval lechole leonso tisha kabbin. vechad amar: kol laacherim, afillu chole leonso ad deikka arbaim sea.
Vechad mehay zuga vechad mehay zuga assefa. chad amar: ha deamar rabbi yehuda arbaim sea mikkol makom — lo shanu ella bekarka, aval bechelim — lo. vechad amar: afillu bechelim name.
Bishlama leman deamar afillu bechelim — hayeynu dekatane rabbi yehuda omer: "arbaim sea mikkol makom". ella leman deamar bekarka — in, bechelim — la, "mikkol makom" leetuye may?
Leetuye mayim sheuvin.

Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua verava berabbi bar shemuel kerichu rifta bahade hadade. amar lehu rav pappa: havu li ledidi livroch, dinful illavay tisha kabbin. amar lehu rava berabbi bar shemuel: tenena, bamme devarim amurim — leatzmo, aval laacherim — arbaim sea. ella, havu li ledidi livroch, dinful illavay arbaim sea. amar lehu rav huna: havu li ledidi livroch, delekka illavay la hay vela hay.
Rav chama tavel bemaale yoma defischa lehotzi rabbim yede chovatan. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
Mishna haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehu baal keri, lo yafsik, ella yekatztzer.

Yarad litbol, im yachol laalot ulehitkassot velikrot ad shello tehe hanetz hachamma — yaale veyitkasse veyikra, veim lav — yitkasse bemayim veyikra. velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim velo beme hammishra, ad sheyyatil letochan mayim. vechamma yarchik mehen umin hatztzoa — arba ammot.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehu baal keri — lo yafsik, ella yekatztzer. haya kore battora venizkar shehu baal keri — eno mafsik veole, ella megamgem vekore. rabbi meir omer: en baal keri rashshay likrot battora yoter mishshelosha pesukim.
Tanya iddach: haya omed bitfilla veraa tzoa kenegdo — mehallech lefanav ad sheyyizrekenna laachorav arba ammot. vehatanya litzdadin. la kashya, ha, deefshar, ha, dela efshar.

Haya mitpallel umatza tzoa bimkomo, amar rabba: af al pi shechata — tefillato tefilla. matkif leh rava: veha: "zevach reshaim toeva"! ella amar rava: hoil vechata, af al pi shehitpallel — tefillato toeva.

Tanu rabbanan: haya omed bitfilla umayim shottin al birkav — posek ad sheyyichlu hammayim vechozer umitpallel. lehechan chozer? rav chisda verav hamenuna, chad amar chozer larosh, vechad amar: lemakom sheppasak.
Lema beha kamippalgi:

a: Mar savar: im shaha kede ligmor et kullah — chozer larosh. umar savar: lemakom sheppasak.

Amar rav ashe: hay "im shaha", im lo shaha mibbee leh! ella, dechulle alma im shaha kede ligmor et kullah — chozer larosh, vehatam bidlo shaha kamippalgi, demar savar gavra dechuya hu, veen rauy, veen tefillato tefilla. umar savar gavra chazya hu, utefillato tefilla.

Tanu rabbanan: hannitzrach linkavav — al yitpallel, veim hitpallel — tefillato toeva. amar rav zevid veittema rav yehuda: lo shanu ella sheeno yachol lishhot beatzmo, aval im yachol lishhot beatzmo — tefillato tefilla.

Vead kamma? amar rav sheshet: ad parsa. ikka dematne la ammatnita: bamme devarim amurim — kesheen yachol laamod al atzmo. aval im yachol laamod al atzmo — tefillato tefilla. vead kamma? amar rav zevid: ad parsa.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: hannitzrach linkavav — hare ze lo yitpallel, mishshum shenneemar: "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael".

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv: "shemor raglecha kaasher telech el bet haelohim"? shemor atzmecha shello techta, veim techta — have korban lefanay. "vekarov lishmoa divre chachamim", amar rava: heve karov lishmoa divre chachamim, sheim chotim meviim korban veosim teshuva. "mittet hakkesilim zavach" — al tehi kakkesilim shechotim umeviim korban, veen osim teshuva.

"Ki enam yodim laasot ra" i hachi tzaddikim ninhu! ella, al tehi kakkesilim shechotim umeviim korban, veenam yodim im al hattova hem meviim, im al haraa hem meviim. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ben tov lera enan mavchinim, vehem meviim korban lefanay?!
Rav ashe veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa amar: shemor nekavecha beshaa sheatta omed bitfilla lefanay.

Tanu rabbanan: hannichnas levet hakkisse, choletz tefillav berichuk arba ammot, venichnas. amar rav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet: lo shanu ella bet hakkisse kavua, aval bet hakkisse aray — choletz, venifne lealtar. ucheshehu yotze — marchik arba ammot, umannichan, mippene sheasao bet hakkisse kavua.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu sheyyikkanes adam bitfillin levet hakkisse kavua lehashetin mayim? ravina share, rav adda bar matna asar. ato shayylu lerava, amar lehu: asur — chayyshinan shemma yippane bahen. veamri la, shemma yafiach bahen.

Tanya iddach: hannichnas levet hakkisse kavua choletz tefillav berichuk arba ammot, umannichan bachallon hassamuch lirshut harabbim, venichnas. ucheshehu yotze — marchik arba ammot, umannichan, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: ochazan beyado, venichnas. rabbi akiva omer: ochazan bevigdo, venichnas.
Bevigdo salka datach?! zimnin mishtele lehu venafli! ella ema: ochazan bevigdo uveyado, venichnas.
Umannicham bachorin hassemuchim levet hakkisse, velo yannichem bachorin hassemuchim lirshut harabbim, shemma yittelu otam ovre derachim, veyavo lide chashad.

Umaase betalmid echad shehinniach tefillav bachorin hassemuchim lirshut harabbim, uvat zona achat, unetalatan, uvat levet hammidrash veamra: reu ma natan li peloni bischari! kevan sheshshama oto talmid kach, ala lerosh haggag venafal vamet. beotah shaa hitkinu sheyyehe ochazan bevigdo uveyado, venichnas.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu mannichin tefillin bachorin hassemuchim levet hakkisse, uvain achbarim venotlin otan. hitkinu sheyyehu mannichin otan bachallonot hassemuchot lirshut harabbim; uvain ovre derachim venotlin otan. hitkinu sheyyehe ochazan beyado venichnas.

Amar rabbi meyasha bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha, gollan kemin sefer, veochazan bimino keneged libbo. amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: uvilvad shello tehe retzua yotzet mittachat yado tefach.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rabbi zera: lo shanu ella sheyyesh shehut beyom lelovshan, aval en shehut beyom lelovshan — ose lahen kemin kis tefach, umannichan.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bayyom gollan kemin sefer umannichan beyado keneged libbo, uvallayla ose lahen kemin kis tefach, umannichan.
Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella bichli shehu kilyayn, aval bichli sheeno kilyayn, afillu pachot mittefach.
Amar mar zutera, veittema rav ashe: teda shehare pakkin ketannim matztzilin beohel hammet.

Amar rabba bar bar chana: ki hava azlinan batreh derabbi yochanan, ki hava bae lemeal levet hakkisse ki hava naket sifra deaggadta — hava yahev lan, ki hava naket tefillin — la hava yahev lan, amar: hoil usheronhu rabbanan —
b: Ninteran. amar rava: ki hava azlinan batreh derav nachman, ki hava naket sifra deaggadta — yahev lan, ki hava naket tefillin — la yahev lan, amar: hoil usheronhu rabbanan, ninteran.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yochaz adam tefillin beyado vesefer tora bizroo veyitpallel. velo yashtin bahen mayim, velo yishan bahen lo shenat keva velo shenat aray. amar shemuel: sakkin umaot ukeara vechikkar, hare ellu kayyotze bahen.
Amar rava amar rav sheshet: let hilcheta ki ha matnita, devet shammay hi. dei bet hillel — hasheta bet hakkisse kavua shere, bet hakkisse aray mibbaya?!

Metivi: devarim shehittarti lecha kan, asarti lecha kan. may lav tefillin? i amrat bishlama bet hillel: hittarti lecha kan kavua, asarti lecha kan bet hakkisse aray. ella i amrat bet shammay ha la sharu vela midde?
Ki tanya hahi, leinyan tefach vetifchayim. detane chada: keshehu nifne — megalle leacharav tefach ulefanav tifchayim. vetanya iddach: leacharav tefach ulefanav velo chelum.
May lav idde veidde beish, vela kashya, kan ligdolim, kan liktannim?
Vetisbera?! i biktannim, leacharav tefach lema li? ella idde veidde bigdolim, vela kashya, ha beish, ha baishsha.
I hachi ha dekatane ala, "zehu kal vachomer sheen alav teshuva" — may "en alav teshuva"? darka demilleta hachi ita.
Ella lav, tefillin, uteyuveta derava amar rav sheshet. teyuveta.
Mikkol makom, kashya, hasheta bet hakkisse kavua shere, bet hakkisse aray lo kol shekken!
Hachi kaamar: bet hakkisse kavua delekka nitzotzot, sharu. bet hakkisse aray deikka nitzotzot, asri.
I hachi, ammay "en alav teshuva"? teshuva meallayta hi!
Hachi kaamar: ha milleta tete la betorat tama, vela tete la bekal vachomer, dei atya la betorat kal vachomer, zehu kal vachomer sheen alav teshuva.
Tanu rabbanan: harotze likkanes lisudat keva, mehallech asara peamim arba ammot, o arbaa peamim eser ammot, veyippane, veachar kach nichnas.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: hannichnas lisudat keva, choletz tefillav veachar kach nichnas. ufeliga derabbi chiyyay, deamar rabbi chiyyay: mannichan al shulchano, vechen hadur lo.
Vead emat? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ad zeman beracha.
Tane chada: tzorer adam tefillav im meotav baafarkesuto. vetanya iddach: lo yatzor.

La kashya, ha deazmeneh. ha dela azmeneh. deamar rav chisda: hay sudara ditfillin deazmeneh lemetzar beh tefillin, tzar beh tefillin — asur lemetzar beh peshite, azmeneh vela tzar beh, tzar beh vela azmeneh — shere lemetzar beh zuzi.
Uleabbaye deamar hazemana milleta hi: azmeneh af al gav dela tzar beh. tzar beh, i azmeneh — asir, i la azmeneh — la.

Bea minneh rav yosef bereh derav nechuneya merav yehuda: mahu sheyyanniach adam tefillav tachat meraashotav? tachat margelotav la ka mibbaya li, shennoheg bahen minhag bizzayon. ki ka mibbaya li, tachat meraashotav may? amar leh hachi amar shemuel: muttar, afillu ishto immo.

Metivi: la yanniach adam tefillav tachat margelotav mippene shennoheg bahem derech bizzayon, aval mannicham tachat meraashotav. veim hayta ishto immo — asur. haya makom sheggavoah shelosha tefachim o namuch shelosha tefachim — muttar.
Teyuveta dishmuel, teyuveta.
Amar rava: af al gav detanya teyuveta dishmuel, hilcheta kevoteh. may tama?

a: Kol lenattorinhu tefe adif. vehecha mannach lehu? amar rabbi yirmeya: ben kar lecheset, shello keneged rosho.
Veha tane rabbi chiyyay: mannichan bechova, tachat meraashotav! demappek leh lemuresha dechova levar.
Bar kappara tzayayr lehu bechilleta, umappik lemureshhon levar. rav shisha bereh derav idde mannach lehu ashsharshifa, ufares sudara illavayyhu.

Amar rav hamenuna bereh derav yosef: zimna chada hava kaemna kammeh derava, vaamar li: zil ayyti li tefillin. veashkachtinhu ben kar lecheset, shello keneged rosho. vahava yadana deyom tevila hava, uleagmoran halacha lemaase hu daavad.

Bea minneh rav yosef bereh derav nechuneya merav yehuda: shenayim sheyyeshenim bemitta achat, mahu shezze yachazir panav veyikra keriat shema, veze yachazir panav veyikra keriat shema? amar leh: hachi amar shemuel: vaafillu ishto immo.
Matkif la rav yosef: ishto vela mibbaya acher?! adderabba, ishto kegufo, acher lav kegufo.

Metivi: shenayim sheyyeshenim bemitta achat — ze machazir panav vekore, veze machazir panav vekore. vetanya achariti: hayyashen bammitta, uvanav uvene veto betziddo, hare ze lo yikra keriat shema, ella im ken hayta tallit mafseket benehen. veim hayu banav uvene veto ketannim — muttar.
Bishlama lerav yosef la kashya, ha ishto, veha beacher. ella lishmuel kashya?

Amar lecha shemuel: lerav yosef mi nicha? vehatanya haya yashen bammitta, uvanav uvene veto bammitta — lo yikra keriat shema ella im ken hayta tallito mafseket benehen. ella may it lach lememar — ishto lerav yosef tannae hi, ledidi name tannae hi.

Amar mar: ze machazir panav vekore keriat shema. veha ikka agavot! mesayyay leh lerav huna, deamar rav huna: agavot en bahem mishshum erva. lema mesayyay leh lerav huna: haishsha yoshevet, vekotza lah challatah arumma, mippene sheyyechola lechassot paneha bekarka, aval lo haish.
Targema rav nachman bar yitzchak: kegon shehayu paneha tuchot bakkarka.

Amar mar: im hayu banav uvene beto ketannim, muttar: vead kamma? amar rav chisda: tinoket bat shalosh shanim veyom echad, vetinok ben tesha shanim veyom echad. ikka deamri: tinoket bat achat esre shana veyom echad, vetinok ben shetem esre shana veyom echad. idde veidde ad keday "shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach".

Amar leh rav kahana lerav ashe: hatam amar rava: af al gav dityuveta dishmuel, hilcheta kevoteh dishmuel. hacha may? amar leh: attu kullehu bachada mechita mechitinhu? ella hecha deittemar — ittemar, vehecha dela ittemar — la ittemar.
Amar leh rav mari lerav pappa: sear yotze bevigdo mahu? kera aleh: sear, sear.

Amar Rabbi yitzchak: tefach baishsha erva. lemay? illema leistakkole ba, veha amar rav sheshet: lamma mana hakkatuv tachshitin shebbachutz im tachshitin shebbifnim — lomar lach kol hammistakkel beetzba ketanna shel ishsha, keillu mistakkel bimkom hattoref.
Ella beishto velikriat shema.

Amar rav chisda: shok baishsha erva, shenneemar: "galli shok ivri neharot", uchetiv: "tiggal ervatech vegam terae cherpatech". amar shemuel: kol baishsha — erva, shenneemar: "ki kolech arev umarech nave". amar rav sheshet: sear baishsha erva, shenneemar: "saarech keeder haizzim".
Amar rabbi chanina: ani raiti et rabbi shettala tefillav. metivi: hattole tefillav yittalu lo chayyav!
Dorshe chamurot amru: "vehayu chayyecha teluim lecha minneged", ze hattole tefillav.
La kashya ha birtzua. ha biktzitza.
Veibbaet ema: la shena retzua vela shena ketzitza — asur. vechi tela rabbi — bechista tela.
I hachi may lememra? mahu detema tive hannacha kesefer tora — ka mashma lan.
Veamar rabbi chanina: ani raiti et rabbi sheggihek ufihek venitattesh verak
b: Umemashmesh bevigdo, aval lo haya mitattef. ucheshehu mefahek haya manniach yado al santero.
Metivi: hammashmia kolo bitfillato — hare ze mikketanne amana. hammagbiah kolo bitfillato hare ze minnevie hashsheker.
Megahek umefahek — hare ze miggasse haruach. hammitattesh bitfillato — siman ra lo. veyesh omrim: nikkar shehu mechoar. harak bitfillato — keillu rak bifne hammelech.
Bishlama megahek umefahek la kashya: kan leonso, kan lirtzono. ella mitattesh ammitattesh kashya!

Mitattesh ammitattesh name la kashya, kan millemala, kan millematta. deamar rav zera: ha milleta ibbala li be rav hamenuna utekila li ki kulle talmuday: hammitattesh bitfillato siman yafe lo, keshem sheosim lo nachat ruach millematta, kach osim lo nachat ruach millemala.

Ella rak arak kashya! rak arak name la kashya, efshar kidrav yehuda. deamar rav yehuda: haya omed bitfilla venizdammen lo rok — mavlio betallito. veim tallit nae hu — mavlio baafarkesuto. ravina hava kae achore rav ashe, nizdammen lo rok, patkeh laachoreh. amar leh: la savar la mar leha derav yehuda mavlio baafarkesuto? amar leh: ana anina datay.

Hammashmia kolo bitfillato hare ze mikketanne amana. amar rav huna: lo shanu, ella sheyyachol lechavvevn et libbo belachash, aval en yachol lechavvevn et libbo belachash — muttar. vehane mille, beyachid, aval betzibbur — ate lemitrad tzibbura.

Rabbi abba hava ka mishtemit minneh derav yehuda dahava ka bae lemissak leara deyisrael, deamar rav yehuda: kol haole mibbavel leeretz yisrael — over baase, shenneemar: "bavela yuvau veshamma yihyu ad yom pokdi otam neum Adonai". amar: ezil veeshma minneh milleta mibbet vavada, vahadar eppoyk.

Azal, ashkecheh letanna dekatane kammeh derav yehuda: haya omed bitfilla venitattesh — mamtin ad sheyyichle haruach vechozer umitpallel. ikka deamri: haya omed bitfilla uvikkesh lehitattesh — marchik leacharav arba ammot, umitattesh, umamtin ad sheyyichle haruach, vechozer umitpallel, veomer: "ribbono shel olam, yetzartanu nekavim nekavim chalulim chalulim, galuy veyadua lefanecha cherpatenu uchelimmatenu bechayyenu uveacharitenu rimma vetolea", umatchil mimmakom sheppasak.
Amar leh: illu lo bati ella lishmoa davar ze — dayyi.
Tanu rabbanan: haya yashen betallito, veeno yachol lehotzi et rosho mippene hatztzinna — chotzetz betallito al tzavvaro, vekore keriat shema. veyesh omrim: al libbo.
Vetanna kamma hare libbo roe et haerva! kasavar libbo roe et haerva — muttar.

Amar rav huna amar rabbi yochanan: haya mehallech bimvoot hametunnafot — manniach yado al piv vekore keriat shema. amar leh rav chisda: haelohim! im amrah li rabbi yochanan befummeh — la tzayetna leh.

Ikka deamri: amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haya mehallech bimvoot hametunnafot — manniach yado al piv vekore keriat shema. amar leh rav chisda: haelohim! im amrah li rabbi yehoshua ben levi befummeh — la tzayetna leh.
Umi amar rav huna hachi? vehaamar rav huna: talmid chacham asur lo laamod bimkom hattinnofet lefi shei efshar lo laamod beli hirhur tora! la kashya, kan — beomed, kan — bimhallech.

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechol makom muttar lehareher bedivre tora, chutz mibbet hammerchatz umibbet hakkisse. vechi tema: hacha name kan beomed kan bimhallech — ini, veha rabbi avahu hava ka azel batreh derabbi yochanan vahava ka kare keriat shema. ki meta bimvoot hametunnafot ishtik. amar leh lerabbi yochanan: lehechan ehdar? amar leh: im shahita kede ligmor et kullah — chazor larosh!
Hachi kaamar leh: ledidi la sevira li, ledidach disvira lach, im shahita kede ligmor et kullah chazor larosh.

Tanya kevateh derav huna, tanya kevateh derav chisda. tanya kevateh derav huna: hamehallech bimvoot hametunnafot — manniach yado al piv veyikra keriat shema. tanya kevateh derav chisda: haya mehallech bimvoot hametunnafot — lo yikra keriat shema, velo od ella sheim haya kore uva — posek.
Lo pasak — may? amar rabbi meyasha bar bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: alav hakkatuv omer: "vegam ani natatti lahem chukkim lo tovim umishpatim lo yichyu bahem".
Rav assi amar: "hoy moshche heavon bechavle hashshav". rav adda bar ahava amar mehacha: "ki devar Adonai baza".
Veim pasak ma secharo? amar rabbi avahu: alav hakkatuv omer: "uvaddavar hazze taarichu yamim".
Amar rav huna: hayta tallito chagura lo al motnav — muttar likrot keriat shema. tanya name hachi: hayta tallito shel beged veshel or veshel sak chagura al motnav — muttar likrot keriat shema.

a: Aval litfilla ad sheyyechasse et libbo.

Veamar rav huna: shachach venichnas bitfillin levet hakkisse — manniach yado alehen ad sheyyigmor. ad sheyyigmor salka datach?! ella kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ad sheyyigmor ammud rishon. velifsok lealtar velekum? mishshum derabban shimon ben gamliel, detanya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ammud hachozer — mevi et haadam lide hidrokan, silon hachozer — mevi et haadam lide yerakon.

Ittemar: tzoa al besaro, o yado munnachat bevet hakkisse, rav huna amar: muttar likrot keriat shema. rav chisda amar: asur likrot keriat shema. amar rava: may tama derav huna — dichtiv: "kol hanneshama tehallel yah haleluyah".
Verav chisda amar: asur likrot keriat shema. may tama derav chisda — dichtiv: "kol atzmotay tomarna Adonai mi chamocha".
Ittemar: reach ra sheyyesh lo ikkar — rav huna amar: marchik arba ammot, vekore keriat shema. verav chisda amar: marchik arba ammot mimmekom sheppasak hareach, vekore keriat shema.

Tanya kevateh derav chisda: lo yikra adam keriat shema, lo keneged tzoat adam, velo keneged tzoat kelavim, velo keneged tzoat chazirim, velo keneged tzoat tarnegolim, velo keneged tzoat ashpa sherechah ra. veim haya makom gavoah asara tefachim o namuch asara tefachim — yoshev betziddo vekore keriat shema. veim lav — marchik mimmennu melo enav. vechen litfilla. reach ra sheyyesh lo ikkar — marchik arba ammot mimmekom hareach, vekore keriat shema.

Amar rava: let hilcheta ki ha matnita bechol hane shematata, ella ki ha detanya: lo yikra adam keriat shema lo keneged tzoat adam, velo keneged tzoat chazirim velo keneged tzoat kelavim bizman shennatan orot letochan.

Beo minneh merav sheshet: reach ra sheen lo ikkar, mahu? amar lehu: ato chazo hane tzippe deve rav, dehane ganu vehane garsi. vehane mille bedivre tora, aval bikriat shema — la. vedivre tora name la amaran, ella dechavreh, aval dideh — la.
Ittemar: tzoa overet — abbaye amar: muttar likrot keriat shema. rava amar: asur likrot keriat shema.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la — ditnan: hattame omed tachat hailan vehattahor over — tame. tahor omed tachat hailan vetame over — tahor. veim amad — tame. vechen beeven hamenuggaat.
Verava amar lach: hatam bikviuta talya milleta, dichtiv "badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo". hacha, "vehaya machanecha kadosh" amar rachamana, veha lekka.
Amar rav pappa: pi chazir ketzoa overet dame. peshita! la tzericha af al gav desalek minnahara.
Amar rav yehuda: sefek tzoa — asura. sefek me raglayim — muttarim. ikka deamri, amar rav yehuda: sefek tzoa, babbayit — mutteret, baashpa — asura. sefek me raglayim — afillu baashpa name muttarin.
Savar la ki ha derav hamenuna, deamar rav hamenuna: lo asra tora ella keneged ammud bilvad.
Vechidrabbi yonatan. derabbi yonatan rame: ketiv "veyad tihye lecha michutz lammachane veyatzata shamma chutz", uchetiv: "veyated tihye lecha vegomer vechissita et tzeatecha".

Ha ketzad? kan bigdolim, kan biktannim. alma ketannim lo asra tora ella keneged ammud bilvad. ha neful leara — shere, verabbanan hu digzaru behu, vechi gezaru behu rabbanan — bevaddaan, aval bisfekan — la gezur.

Uvevaddaan ad kamma? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol zeman shemmatpichin. vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol zeman shemmatpichin. vechen amar ulla: kol zeman shemmatpichin. geniva mishshemeh derav amar: kol zeman sherishshuman nikkar.
Amar rav yosef: shera leh mareh ligniva, hasheta tzoa amar rav yehuda amar rav kevan shekkarmu paneha — muttar, me raglayim mibbaya?!
Amar leh abbaye: may chazet desamchat aha, semoch aha, deamar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: tzoa, afillu kecheres — asura.
Vehechi dame tzoa kecheres? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol zeman shezzorka veenah nifrechet. veikka deamri: kol zeman sheggollah veenah nifrechet.
Amar ravina: hava kaemna kammeh derav yehuda middifti chaza tzoa, amar li: ayyen i karmu paneha i la. ikka deamri hachi amar leh: ayyen i mippelay ippeloye.
May have ala? ittemar: tzoa kecheres, amemar amar asura, umar zutera amar mutteret. amar rava: hilcheta: tzoa kecheres asura, ume raglayim kol zeman shemmatpichin.

Metivi: me raglayim kol zeman shemmatpichin — asurin, nivleu o yavshu — muttarim. may lav nivleu duvmya deyavshu, ma yavshu deen rishshuman nikkar, af nivleu — deen rishshuman nikkar. ha rishshuman nikkar — asur, af al gav deen matpichin!
Uletamaych ema resha: kol zeman shemmatpichin — hu deasur, ha rishshuman nikkar — shere! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.

Lema ketannae: keli shennishpechu mimmennu me raglayim, asur likrot keriat shema kenegdo. ume raglayim atzman shennishpechu, nivleu — muttar, lo nivleu — asur. rabbi yose omer: kol zeman shemmatpichin.

May "nivleu" umay "lo nivleu" dekaamar tanna kamma? ilema nivleu deen matpichin, lo nivleu dematpichin — vaata rabbi yose lememar: kol zeman shemmatpichin hu deasur, ha rishshuman nikkar — shere, hayeynu tanna kamma! ella nivleu deen rishshuman nikkar, lo nivleu — derishshuman nikkar. vaata rabbi yose lememar kol zeman shemmatpichin hu deasur, ha rishshuman nikkar — shere.
La. dechulle alma kol zeman shemmatpichin hu deasur ha rishshuman nikkar — shere,
b: Vehacha betofeach al menat lehatepiach, ikka benayyhu.
Yarad litbol, im yachol laalot kulei: lema tanna setama kerabbi eliezer deamar ad hanetz hachamma?
Afillu tema rabbi yehoshua, vedilma kevatikin. deamar rabbi yochanan: vatikin hayu gomrin otah im hanetz hachamma.
Veim lav — yitkasse bemayim veyikra. vahare libbo roe et haerva?
Amar rabbi elazar, vei tema rabbi acha bar abba bar acha mishshum rabbenu: bemayim achurin shanu, dedamu keara semichta, shello yire libbo ervato.
Tanu rabbanan: mayim tzelulin — yshev bahen ad tzavvaro vekore. veyesh omrim ochran beraglo.
Vetana kamma, vahare libbo roe et haerva! kasavar libbo roe et haerva — muttar. vahare akevo roe et haerva! kasavar akevo roe et haerva muttar.

Ittemar: akevo roe et haerva muttar, nogea — abbaye amar: asur, verava amar: muttar. rav zevid matni la leha shemata hachi. rav chinnana bereh derav ika matni la hachi: nogea — divre hakkol asur, roe — abbaye amar: asur, rava amar: muttar: lo nittena tora lemalache hashsharet. vehilcheta nogea — asur, roe — muttar.

Amar rava: tzoa baashashit, muttar likrot keriat shema kenegdah. erva baashashit, asur likrot keriat shema kenegdah. tzoa baashashit muttar likrot keriat shema kenegdah detzoa bechissuy talya milleta, veha mikkasseya. erva baashashit asur likrot keriat shema kenegdah, "velo yire vecha ervat davar" amar rachamana. veha kamitchazya.
Amar abbaye: tzoa kol shehu, mevattelah berok. amar rava: uverok ave. amar rava: tzoa begumma — manniach sandalo aleha, vekore keriat shema. bea mar bereh deravina: tzoa devuka besandalo — may? teku.

Amar rav yehuda: goy arom asur likrot keriat shema kenegdo. may irya goy? afillu yisrael name! yisrael peshita leh deasur, ella goy itztericha leh mahu detema, hoil uchetiv behu "asher besar chamorim besaram", ema kachamor bealma hu, ka mashma lan deinhu name ikkeru erva, dichtiv: "veervat avihem lo rau".

Velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim velo beme hammishra ad sheyyatil letochan mayim. vechamma mayya rame veazel? ella hachi kaamar lo yitkasse lo bemayim haraim velo beme hammishra kelal. ume raglayim ad sheyyatil letochan mayim, veyikra.
Tanu rabbanan: kamma yatil letochan mayim — kol shehu. rabbi zakkay omer: reviit.
Amar rav nachman: machaloket levassof. aval battechilla, kol shehen.
Verav yosef amar: machaloket lechattechilla. aval levassof divre hakkol reviit. amar leh rav yosef leshammaeh: ayyeyti li revieta demayya, kerabbi zakkay.

Tanu rabbanan: geraf shel rei veavit shel me raglayim — asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan, veaf al pi sheen bahen kelum. ume raglayim atzman — ad sheyyatil letochan mayim. vechamma yatil letochan mayim — kol shehu. rabbi zakkay omer: reviit. ben lifne hammitta ben leachar hammitta. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: leachar hammitta — kore, lifne hammitta — eno kore, aval marchik hu arba ammot vekore. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: afillu bet mea amma — lo yikra ad sheyyotziem o sheyyannichem tachat hammitta.

Ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar, achar hammitta — kore miyyad, lifne hammitta — marchik arba ammot vekore, o dilma hachi kaamar: leachar hammitta — marchik arba ammot vekore, lifne hammitta — eno kore kelal.

Ta shema, detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: achar hammitta — kore miyyad, lifne hammitta — marchik arba ammot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: afillu bet mea amma — lo yikra ad sheyyotziem o sheyyannichem tachat hammitta.
Bayayn ippeshita lan, matneyayta kashyayn ahadade: efoch batrayyta.
Ma chazet deafchat batrayyta? efoch kammayyta!
Man shamat leh deamar kulleh bayit kearba ammot dame — rabbi shimon ben elazar hi.

Amar rav yosef: beay minneh merav huna: mitta pachot mishshelosha peshita li dichlavud dame. shelosha, arbaa, chamishsha, shishsha, shiva, shemona, tisha, mahu? amar leh: la yadana. asara vadday la mibbee li. amar abbaye: shappir avadt dela ibbaya lecha, kol asara reshuta achariti hi.

Amar rava: hilcheta, pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame. asara — reshuta achariti hi. mishshelosha ad asara — hayeynu diva minneh rav yosef merav huna vela peshat leh. amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. vechen amar bali amar rav yaakov bera devat shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. verava amar: en halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.

Rav achay iassak leh livreh be rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta, ayyeyleh lechuppa, vela hava mistayyeya milleta. azal batreh leayyone, chaza sefer tora demannecha. amar lehu: echu hasheta la atay sakkentun livri. detanya: bayit sheyyesh bo sefer tora o tefillin asur leshammesh bo et hammitta ad sheyyotziem o sheyyannichem keli betoch keli.
Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella bichli sheeno kilyayn, aval bichli shehu kilyayn — afillu asara mane kechad mana dame. amar rava: gelima

a: Akkamtera — kichli betoch keli dame. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: sefer tora — tzarich laasot lo mechitztza asara. mar zutera ikkela leve rav ashe, chazyeh leducheteh demar bar rav ashe demannach beh sefer tora vaaved leh mechitza asara. amar leh: keman? kerabbi yehoshua ben levi? emar deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi delet leh beta acharina, mar ha it leh beta acharina? amar leh: lav addatay.
Kamma yarchik mehen umin hatztzoa — arba ammot. amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna: lo shanu ella laachorav, aval lefanav — marchik melo enav, vechen litfilla.
Ini?! veha amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: omed adam keneged bet hakkisse umitpallel! hacha bemay askinan? bevet hakkisse sheen bo tzoa.
Ini?! vehaamar rav yosef bar chanina: bet hakkisse sheamru af al pi sheen bo tzoa uvet hammerchatz sheamru, af al pi sheen bo adam! ella hacha bemay askinan — bechadte.
Veha mibbee leh leravina: hizmino levet hakkisse, mahu? yesh zimmun, o en zimmun? ki ka mibbee leh leravina: lemekam aleh letzalloye begavveh aval kenegdo — la.
Amar rava: hane batte kissae defarsae af al gav deit behu tzoa — kistumin damu.
Mishna zav sheraa keri, venidda sheppalta shichvat zera, vehameshammeshet sheraata nidda — tzerichin tevila. verabbi yehuda poter.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: baal keri, sheraa ziva lerabbi yehuda mahu? ki patar rabbi yehuda hatam bezav sheraa keri, demeikkara lav bar tevila hu. aval baal keri sheraa ziva, demeikkara bar tevila hu mechayyayv, o dilma la shena.

Ta shema hameshammeshet veraata nidda tzericha tevila, verabbi yehuda poter. veha meshammeshet veraata nidda kevaal keri sheraa ziva damya, veka patar rabbi yehuda, shema minna. tane rabbi chiyyay behedya: baal keri sheraa ziva tzarich tevila, verabbi yehuda poter.
Haderan alach mi shemmetu
Mishna tefillat hashshachar ad chatzot. rabbi yehuda omer: ad arba shaot. tefillat hammincha ad haerev, rabbi yehuda omer: ad pelag hammincha.
Tefillat haerev en lah keva. veshel musafim kol hayyom, rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheva shaot.
Gemara ureminhu: mitzvatah im hanetz hachamma, kede sheyyismoch geulla litfilla, venimtza mitpallel bayyom!
Ki tanya hahi levatikin. deamar rabbi yochanan: vatikin hayu gomrim otah im hanetz hachamma.

Vechulle alma ad chatzot vetu la, vehaamar rav mari bereh derav huna bereh derabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: taa velo hitpallel arvit — mitpallel beshacharit shetayim, shacharit — mitpallel bemincha shetayim.
Kulle yoma metzalle veazel, ad chatzot, yahavi leh sechar tefilla bizmannah, mikkan veelach, sechar tefilla — yahavi leh, sechar tefilla bizmannah — la yahavi leh.

Ibbaya lehu: taa velo hitpallel mincha, mahu sheyyitpallel arvit shetayim? im timtza lomar, taa velo hitpallel arvit mitpallel shacharit shetayim, mishshum dechad yoma hu, dichtiv: "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad", aval hacha tefilla bimkom korban hi, vechevan deavar yomo batal korbano. o dilma kevan ditzlota rachame hi, kol emat devae metzalle veazel.
Ta shema deamar rav huna bar yehuda amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: taa velo hitpallel mincha — mitpallel arvit shetayim, veen baze mishshum deavar yomo batal korbano.

Metivi. "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot": "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon" — ze shebbittel keriat shema shel arvit ukeriat shema shel shacharit, o tefilla shel arvit o tefilla shel shacharit. "vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot" — ze shennimnu chaverav lidvar mitzva, velo nimna immahem.
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: hacha bemay askinan — shebbittel bemezid.
Amar rav ashe: dayka name, dekatane "bittel", vela katane "taa", shema minna.
b: Tanu rabbanan: taa velo hitpallel mincha beerev shabbat — mitpallel belel shabbat shetayim. taa velo hitpallel mincha beshabbat — mitpallel bemotzae shabbat shetayim shel chol. mavdil barishona, veeno mavdil bishniyya. veim hivdil bashsheniyya velo hivdil barishona — sheniyya alta lo, rishona lo alta lo.
Lememra dechevan dela avdil bekammayyta keman dela tzalli dame, umahderinan leh?

Ureminhu: taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyayt hammetim usheela bevirkat hashshanim — machazirin oto. havedala bechonen haddaat" en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos! kashya.
Ittemar, rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: tefillot avot tikkenum. rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: tefillot keneged temidin tikkenum.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yose berabbi chanina, vetanya kevoteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi. tanya kevoteh derabbi yose berabbi chanina: avraham tikken tefillat shacharit, shenneemar: "vayyashkem avraham babboker el hammakom asher amad sham", veen "amida" ella tefilla, shenneemar: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel".
Yitzchak tikken tefillat mincha, shenneemar "vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot arev", veen "sicha" ella tefilla, shenneemar "tefilla leani chi yaatof velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho".

Yaakov tikken tefillat arvit, shenneemar: "vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham", veen "pegia" ella tefilla, shenneemar: "veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utefilla veal tifga bi"

Vetanya kevoteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: mippene ma amru tefillat hashshachar ad chatzot — shehare tamid shel shachar karev veholech ad chatzot. verabbi yehuda omer: ad arba shaot shehare tamid shel shachar karev veholech ad arba shaot.

Umippene ma amru tefillat hammincha ad haerev — shehare, tamid shel ben haarbayim karev veholech ad haerev. rabbi yehuda omer: ad pelag hammincha, shehare tamid shel ben haarbayim karev veholech ad pelag hammincha.
Umippene ma amru tefillat haerev en lah keva — shehare evarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, kerevim veholchim kol hallayla.
Umippene ma amru shel musafin kol hayyom — shehare korban shel musafin karev kol hayyom. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheva shaot, shehare korban musaf karev veholech ad sheva shaot.
Veezo hi mincha gedola mishshesh shaot umechetza ulemala. veezo hi mincha ketanna mittesha shaot umechetza ulemala.
Ibbaya lehu: rabbi yehuda, pelag mincha kamma kaamar o pelag mincha acharona kaamar? ta shema detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: pelag hammincha acharona amru, vehi achat esre shaot chaser revia.

Nema tehve teyuveteh derabbi yose berabbi chanina? amar lecha rabbi yose berabbi chanina: leolam ema lach, tefillot, avot tikkenum, veasmechinhu rabbanan akkorbanot. dei la tema hachi, tefillat musaf lerabbi yose berabbi chanina man takkena. ella tefillot avot tikkenum, veasmechinhu rabbanan akkorbanot.

Rabbi yehuda omer ad arba shaot. ibbaya lehu: ad vead bakkelal, o dilma ad velo ad bakkelal?! ta shema rabbi yehuda omer: ad pelag hammincha. i amrat bishlama ad velo ad bakkelal — hayeynu deikka ben rabbi yehuda lerabbanan. ella i amrat ad vead bakkelal, rabbi yehuda

a: Hayeynu rabbanan!

Ella may, ad velo ad bakkelal? ema sefa: veshel musafin kol hayyom. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheva shaot. vetanya: hayu lefanav shete tefillot, achat shel musaf veachat shel mincha — mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach shel musaf, shezzo tedira, vezo enah tedira. rabbi yehuda omer: mitpallel shel musaf veachar kach shel mincha, shezzo overet, vezo enah overet.

I amrat bishlama "ad vead bakkelal", hayeynu demashkachat lehu shete tefillot bahade hadade. ella i amrat "ad velo ad bakkelal", hechi mashkachat lehu shete tefillot bahade hadade? kevan deatya la shel mincha, azla la shel musafin!

Ella may, "ad vead bakkelal"? kashya resha, may ikka ben rabbi yehuda lerabbanan?! — mi savrat dehay "pelag mincha" pelag acharona kaamar? pelag rishona kaamar, vehachi kaamar: emat nafek pelag rishona veayel pelag acharona — mikki nafki achat esre shaot chaser revia.
Amar rav nachman: af anan name tenena.

Rabbi yehuda ben bava heid chamishsha devarim: shemmaanin et hakketanna, veshemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad, veal tarnegol shenniskal birushalayim al sheharag et hannefesh, veal yayin ben arbaim yom shennitnassech al gabbe hammizbeach, veal tamid shel shachar shekkarev bearba shaot.
Shema minna "ad vead bakkelal". shema minna.
Amar rav kahana: halacha kerabbi yehuda, hoil utenan bivchirata kevoteh.
Veal tamid shel shachar shekkarev bearba shaot, man tena leha ditnan: "vecham hashshemesh venamas", bearba shaot.

Atta omer bearba shaot, o eno ella beshesh shaot?! keshehu omer "kechom hayyom", hare shesh shaot amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "vecham hashshemesh venamas" — bearba shaot. manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbanan. i rabbi yehuda ad arba shaot name tzafra hu! i rabbanan — ad chatzot name tzafra hu.

I baet ema rabbi yehuda, i baet ema rabbanan: i baet ema rabbanan: amar kera "babboker babboker" — challekehu lishne bekarim. vei baet ema rabbi yehuda: hay boker yattira — lehakedim lo shaa achat. dechulla alma miha "vecham hashshemesh venamas" bearba shaot.
May mashma? amar rabbi acha bar yaakov: amar kera "vecham hashshemesh venamas" — ezo hi shaa shehashshemesh cham vehatztzel tzonen — heve omer bearba shaot.

Tefillat hammincha ad haerev vechulei. amar leh rav chisda lerav yitzchak: hatam amar rav kahana halacha kerabbi yehuda, hoil utenan bivchirata kevoteh, hacha may? ishtik vela amar leh vela midde. amar rav chisda: nechze anan, midderav metzalle shel shabbat beerev shabbat mibbeod yom, shema minna halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Adderabba midderav huna verabbanan la havo metzallu ad ureta, shema minna en halacha kerabbi yehuda. hasheta dela ittemar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar, daavad kemar — avad, vedaavad kemar — avad.

Rav ikkela leve geniva vetzalli shel shabbat beerev shabbat, vahava metzalle rabbi yirmeya bar abba laachore derav, vesayyem rav vela paskeh litzloteh derabbi yirmeya. shema minna telat: shema minna mitpallel adam shel shabbat beerev shabbat. ushema minna mitpallel talmid achore rabbo. ushema minna asur laavor keneged hammitpallelin.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur laavor keneged hammitpallelin. ini?! veha rabbi amme verabbi assi chalfi. rabbi amme verabbi assi — chutz learba ammot hu dechalfi.
Verabbi yirmeya hechi aved hachi?! veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam al yitpallel adam
b: Lo keneged rabbo, velo achore rabbo.

Vetanya, rabbi eliezer omer: hammitpallel achore rabbo, vehannoten shalom lerabbo, vehammachazir shalom lerabbo, vehacholek al yeshivato shel rabbo, vehaomer davar shello shama mippi rabbo — gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael!
Shane rabbi yirmeya bar abba detalmid chaver hava. vehayeynu dekaamar leh rabbi yirmeya bar abba lerav: mi bedalt? amar leh: in, bedelna, vela amar "mi bedel mar"?

Umi bedel? vehaamar rabbi avin: paam achat hitpallel rabbi shel shabbat beerev shabbat, venichnas lammerchatz, veyatza veshana lan pirkin, vaadayin lo chashcha! amar rava: hahu denichnas lehazzia, vekodem gezera hava.
Ini, veha abbaye shera leh lerav dimi bar levay lechavroye salle!
Hahu tauta havay.

Vetauta mi hadra? veha amar avidan: paam achat nitkashsheru shamayim beavim, kisvurim haam lomar chashecha hu, nichnesu levet hakkeneset vehitpallelu shel motzae shabbat beshabbat. venitpazzeru heavim vezarcha hachamma,
Uvau veshaalu et rabbi. veamar: hoil vehitpallelu — hitpallelu! shane tzibbur, dela matrechinan lehu.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin: rav tzalli shel shabbat beerev shabbat, rabbi yoshiyya metzalle shel motzae shabbat beshabbat. rav tzalli shel shabbat beerev shabbat: omer kedushsha al hakkos, o eno omer kedushsha al hakkos? ta shema deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: mitpallel adam shel shabbat beerev shabbat veomer kedushsha al hakkos. vehilcheta kevoteh.

Rabbi yoshiyya metzalle shel motzae shabbat beshabbat: omer havedala al hakkos o eno omer havedala al hakkos? ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mitpallel adam shel motzae shabbat beshabbat veomer havedala al hakkos.
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi assi amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina amar rav: betzad ammud ze hitpallel rabbi yishmael berabbi yose shel shabbat beerev shabbat

Ki ata ulla amar: betzad temara hava, velo betzad ammud hava. velo rabbi yishmael berabbi yose hava, ella rabbi elazar berabbi yose hava, velo shel shabbat beerev shabbat hava, ella shel motzae shabbat beshabbat hava.
Tefillat haerev en lah keva. may en lah keva? illema dei bae metzalle kulleh lelya, litne "tefillat haerev kol hallayla"! ella may en lah keva —

Keman deamar, tefillat arvit reshut. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tefillat arvit: rabban gamliel omer chova, rabbi yehoshua omer reshut. amar abbaye: halacha kedivre haomer chova. verava amar: halacha kedivre haomer reshut.
Tanu rabbanan: maase betalmid echad shebba lifne rabbi yehoshua. amar lo: tefillat arvit reshut o chova? amar leh: reshut.
Ba lifne rabban gamliel, amar lo: tefillat arvit reshut o chova? amar lo: chova. amar lo: vahalo rabbi yehoshua amar li reshut?! amar lo: hameten ad sheyyikkansu baale terisin levet hammidrash.

Keshennichnesu baale terisin, amad hashshoel veshaal: tefillat arvit reshut o chova? amar lo rabban gamliel: chova. amar lahem rabban gamliel lachachamim: kelum yesh adam shecholek bedavar ze? amar leh rabbi yehoshua: lav. amar lo: vahalo mishshimcha amru li reshut!

Amar leh: yehoshua, amod al raglecha veyaidu becha. amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar ilmale ani chay vehu met — yachol hachay lehachechish et hammet. veachshav sheani chay vehu chay — heach yachol hachay lehachechish et hachay?
Haya rabban gamliel yoshev vedoresh verabbi yehoshua omed al raglav, ad sherinnenu kol haam veamru lechutzepit hatturegman: amod! veamad.
Amri: ad kamma netzaareh venezil, berosh hashshana eshtakad tzaareh. bivchorot bemaase derabbi tzadok tzaareh. hacha name tzaareh, ta venabereh!
Man nokem leh? nokmeh lerabbi yehoshua — baal maase hu. nokmeh lerabbi akiva — dilma anesh leh, delet leh zechut avot.

Ella nokmeh lerabbi elazar ben azarya, dehu chacham, vehu ashir, vehu asiri leezra. hu chacham — dei makshe leh, mefarek leh. vehu ashir — dei it leh lefalloche leve kesar, af hu azel ufalach. vehu asiri leezra — deit leh zechut avot, vela matze anesh leh. ato vaamaru leh: nicha leh lemar delehve resh metivta? amar lehu: ezil veimmelich beinashe beti. azal veimmelich bidvethu. amara leh:

a: Dilma meabberin lach. amar la: lishtammash inash yoma chada bechasa demokra, velimchar littevar. amara leh: let lacha chivvarata. hahu yoma bar tamne sere shene hava, itrechish leh nissa veihaddaru leh tamne sere dare chivvarata. hayeynu dekaamar rabbi elazar ben azarya: hare ani keven shivim shana. velo "ben shivim shana".
Tana oto hayyom, sillekuhu leshomer happetach venittena lahem reshut lattalmidim likkanes. shehaya rabban gamliel machriz veomer: kol talmid sheen tocho kevaro, lo yikkanes levet hammidrash.

Hahu yoma ittosfu kamma safsalle. amar rabbi yochanan: peligi ba abba yosef ben dostay verabbanan. chad amar: ittosfu arba mea safsalle. vechad amar: sheva mea safsalle. hava ka chalsha dateh derabban gamliel, amar: dilma chas veshalom manati tora miyyisrael. achzo leh bechelmeh chatzve chivvare demalyin kitma. vela hi, hahi leyattove dateh, hu deachzo leh.

Tana: eduyot bo bayyom nishnet. vechol hecha deamrinan "bo bayyom", hahu yoma hava. velo hayta halacha shehayta teluya bevet hammidrash shello pershuha. veaf rabban gamliel lo mana atzmo mibbet hammidrash afillu shaa achat.
Ditnan: bo bayyom ba yehuda ger ammoni lifnehem bevet hammidrash. amar lahem: ma ani lavo bakkahal?

Amar lo rabban gamliel: asur atta lavo bakkahal. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: muttar atta lavo bakkahal. amar lo rabban gamliel: vahalo kevar neemar "lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai"? amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vechi ammon umoav bimkoman hen yoshvin? kevar ala sancheriv melech ashshur uvilbel et kol haummot, shenneemar: "veasir gevulot ammim vaatudotehem shoseti veorid kabbir yoshvim", vechol defaresh — merubba paresh.
Amar lo rabban gamliel: vahalo kevar neemar "veachare chen ashiv et shevut bene ammon neum Adonai", uchevar shavu!
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vahalo kevar neemar "veshavti et shevut ammi yisrael", vaadayin lo shavu. miyyad hittiruhu lavo bakkahal.

Amar rabban gamliel: hoil vehachi hava, ezil vaafayyeyseh lerabbi yehoshua. ki meta leveteh, chazinhu leashyata deveteh demashcharan. amar leh: mikkotle vetcha atta nikkar sheppechami atta. amar lo: oy lo laddor sheatta parnaso, shei atta yodea betzaaran shel talmide chachamim, bamme hem mitparnesim uvamme hem nizzonim.
Amar lo: naaneti lecha mechol li. la ashgach beh: ase bishvil kevod abba. payyes.

Amaru: man nezil velema lehu lerabbanan. amar lehu hahu koves: ana azelna. shelach lehu rabbi yehoshua leve midresha: man delavesh madda — yilbash madda, uman dela lavesh madda yemar leh leman delavesh madda: shelach maddach vaana elbesheh?! amar lehu rabbi akiva lerabbanan: teruku galle dela letu avde derabban gamliel uletzaaru lerabbanan.

Amar rabbi yehoshua: mutav deekum veezil ana legabbayyhu. ata teraf abbava. amar lehu: mazze ben mazze yazze. vesheeno lo mazze velo ben mazze yomar lemazze ben mazze memecha me meara veefrecha efer mikle. amar lo rabbi akiva: rabbi yehoshua, nitpayyaysta? kelum asinu ella bishvil kevodcha, lemachar ani veatta nashkim lefitcho.

Amri: hechi naaved, nabereh — gemiri maalin bakkodesh veen moridin. nidrosh mar chada shabbeta umar chada shabbeta — ate lekannooye. ella: lidrosh rabban gamliel telata shabbate verabbi elazar ben azarya chada shabbeta. vehayeynu deamar mar shabbat shel mi hayta — shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta. veoto talmid rabbi shimon ben yochay hava.
Veshel musafin kol hayyom. amar rabbi yochanan: venikra "poshea".

Tanu rabbanan: hayu lefanav shete tefillot, achat shel mincha veachat shel musaf — mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musaf, shezzo tedira, vezo enah tedira. rabbi yehuda omer: mitpallel shel musaf veachar kach mitpallel shel mincha, shezzo mitzva overet, vezo mitzva sheenah overet. amar rabbi yochanan: halacha mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musaf.

Rabbi zera ki hava chalish miggirseh hava azel veyatev appitcha deve rabbi natan bar tovi. amar: ki chalfi rabbanan az ekum mikkammayyhu vaakabbel agra. nefak ata rabbi natan bar tovi, amar leh: man amar halacha be midresha? amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: en halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar mitpallel adam shel musaf veachar kach mitpallel shel mincha.
Amar leh: rabbi yochanan amra? amar leh: in. tena minneh arbein zimnin. amar leh: chada hi lach, o chadat hi lach? amar leh: chadat hi li, mishshum dimsappeka li berabbi yehoshua ben levi.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hammitpallel tefilla shel musafin leachar sheva shaot lerabbi yehuda alav hakkatuv omer: "nuge mimmoed asafti mimmech hayu". may mashma dehay nuge lishshana ditvara hu? kedimtargem rav yosef: tevara ate al sanehon devet yisrael al deacharu zimne moadayya devirushelem.

Amar rabbi elazar: kol hammitpallel tefilla shel shacharit leachar arba shaot lerabbi yehuda alav hakkatuv omer: "nuge mimmoed asafti mimmech hayu". may mashma dehay nuge lishshana detzaara hu? dichtiv: "dalfa nafshi mittuga". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mehacha: "betuloteha nugot vehi mar lah".
b: Rav avya chalash vela ata lefirka derav yosef. limchar ki ata, bea abbaye leannoche dateh derav yosef. amar leh: may tama la ata mar lefirka? amar leh: dahava chalish libbay vela matzena. amar leh: ammay la teamt midde vaatet? amar leh: la savar la mar leha derav huna? deamar rav huna: asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat hammusafin! amar leh: ibbei leh lemar letzalloye tzelota demusafin beyachid, velitom midde ulemete. amar leh: vela savar la mar leha deamar rabbi yochanan: asur lo laadam sheyyakdim tefillato litfillat hatztzibbur? amar leh: lav ittemar ala amar rabbi abba betzibbur shanu.

Velet hilcheta la kerav huna vela kerabbi yehoshua ben levi: kerav huna — ha daamaran. kerabbi yehoshua ben levi — deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kevan shehiggia zeman tefillat mincha, asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat hammincha.

Mishna rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya mitpallel bichnisato levet hammidrash uvitziato tefilla ketzara. amru lo: ma makom litfilla zo? amar lahem: bichnisati ani mitpallel shello yeera devar takkala al yadi. uvitziati ani noten hodaa al chelki.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: bichnisato mahu omer? "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shello yeera devar takkala al yadi, velo ekkashel bidvar halacha, veyismechu bi chaveray, velo omar al tame tahor, velo al tahor tame. velo yikkashlu chaveray bidvar halacha, veesmach bahem".

Bitziato mahu omer? "mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shessamta chelki miyyoshve bet hammidrash velo samta chelki miyyoshve keranot. sheani mashkim, vehem mashkimim. ani mashkim ledivre tora, vehem mashkimim lidvarim betelim. ani amel vehem amelim. ani amel umekabbel sachar, vehem amelim veenam mekabbelim sachar. ani ratz vehem ratzim. ani ratz lechayye haolam habba vehem ratzim liver shachat".
Tanu rabbanan: keshechala rabbi eliezer nichnesu talmidav levakkero. amru lo: rabbenu lammedenu orchot chayyim venizke bahen lechayye haolam habba.

Amar lahem: hizzaharu bichvod chavrechem, uminu benechem min hahiggayon, vehoshivum ben birke talmide chachamim, uchesheattem mitpallelim — deu lifne mi attem omdim. uvishvil kach tizku lechayye haolam habba.
Ucheshechala rabbi yochanan ben zakkay nichnesu talmidav levakkero. kevan sheraa otam hitchil livkot. amru lo talmidav: "ner yisrael, ammud hayemani, pattish hechazak", mippene ma atta boche?

Amar lahem: illu lifne melech basar vadam hayu molichin oti, shehayyom kan umachar bakkever, sheim koes alay en kaaso kaas olam, veim osreni — en issuro issur olam, veim memiteni — en mitato mitat olam, vaani yachol lefayyeyso bidvarim uleshachado bemamon, af al pi chen hayiti boche, veachshav shemmolichim oti lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu, shehu chay vekayyaym leolam uleolme olamim, sheim koes alay — kaaso kaas olam, veim osreni — issuro issur olam, veim memiteni — mitato mitat olam, veeni yachol lefayyeyso bidvarim velo leshachado bemamon. velo od, ella sheyyesh lefanay shene derachim, achat shel gan eden veachat shel gehinnam, veeni yodea beezo molichim oti, velo evke?!

Amru lo: rabbenu, barchenu. amar lahem: "yehi ratzon shettehe mora shamayim alechem kemora basar vadam". amru lo talmidav: ad kan? amar lahem: ulevay, tedu kesheadam over avera omer: "shello yirani adam".
Bishat petirato, amar lahem: pannu kelim mippene hattumea, vehachinu kisse lechizkiyyahu melech yehuda shebba.

Mishna rabban gamliel omer: bechol yom veyom mitpallel adam shemone esre. rabbi yehoshua omer: meen shemone esre. rabbi akiva omer: im shegura tefillato befiv — mitpallel shemone esre, veim lav — meen shemone esre.
Rabbi eliezer omer: haose tefillato keva — en tefillato tachanunim.

Rabbi yehoshua omer: haholech bimkom sakkana, mitpallel tefilla ketzara, veomer: "hosha Adonai et ammecha et sheerit yisrael, bechol parashat haibbur yihyu tzorchehem lefanecha. baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".

Haya rochev al hachamor — yered veyitpallel, veim eno yachol lered — yachazir et panav. veim eno yachol lehachazir et panav — yechavven et libbo keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim. haya mehallech bisfina o beasda — yechavven et libbo keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim.
Gemara hane shemone esre keneged mi?

Amar rabbi hillel bereh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani: keneged shemone esre azkarot sheamar david behavu laAdonai bene elim". rav yosef amar: keneged shemone esre azkarot shebbikriat shema. amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: keneged shemone esre chuleyot shebbashshidra.
Veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyichra ad sheyyitpakkeku kol chuleyot shebbashshidra.
Ulla amar: ad kede sheyyire issar keneged libbo. rabbi chanina amar: kevan shennina rosho — shuv eno tzarich. amar rava: vehu dimtzaar nafsheh, umichze keman dechara.
Hane tamne sere?! teshasre havvyan!
Amar rabbi levi: birkat hamminim beyavne tikkenuha. keneged mi tikkenuha.

Amar rabbi levi lerabbi hillel bereh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani: keneged "el hakkavod hirim". lerav yosef, keneged "echad" shebbikriat shema. lerabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, keneged chuleya ketanna shebbashshidra.

Tanu rabbanan: shimon happakoli hisdir shemone esre berachot lifne rabban gamliel al hasseder beyavne. amar lahem rabban gamliel lachachamim: kelum yesh adam sheyyodea letakken birkat hamminim? amad shemuel hakkatan vetikkenah.
Leshana acheret shechachah,

a: Vehishkif bah shetayim veshalosh shaot, velo heeluhu.
Ammay lo heeluhu? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: taa bechol habberachot kullan — en maalin oto, bevirkat hamminim — maalin oto. chayyshinan shemma min hu?
Shane shemuel hakkatan deihu takkena.
Venechush dilma hadar beh. amar abbaye: gemiri, tava la have bisha.
Vela?! vehachtiv: "uveshuv tzaddik mitztzidkato veasa avel". hahu rasha meikkaro, aval tzaddik meikkaro — la.
Vela?! veha tenan: al taamin beatzmecha ad yom motcha, shehare yochanan kohen gadol shimmesh bichhunna gedola shemonim shana ulevassof naasa tzadoki.
Amar abbaye: hu yannay, hu yochanan. rava amar: yannay lechud veyochanan lechud, yannay — rasha meikkaro, veyochanan — tzaddik meikkaro. hannicha leabbaye, ella lerava kashya.
Amar lach rava: tzaddik meikkaro name dilma hadar beh. i hachi, ammay la assekuhu?
Shane shemuel hakkatan deatchel ba. deamar rav yehuda amar rav, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo shanu, ella shello hitchil bah, aval hitchil bah — gomrah.
Hane sheva deshabbeta keneged mi? amar rabbi chalafta ben shaul: keneged shiva "kolot" sheamar david al hammayim.
Hane tesha derosh hashshana keneged mi? amar rabbi yitzchak demin kartignin: keneged tisha azkarot sheamra channa bitfillatah, deamar mar: berosh hashshana nifkeda sara rachel vechanna.

Hane esrim vearba detaanita keneged mi? amar rabbi chelbo: keneged esrim vearba "renanot" sheamar shelomo beshaa shehichnis aron levet kodshe hakkodashim: i hachi, kol yoma name nemrinhu! emat amrinhu shelomo — beyoma derachame, anan name beyoma derachame amrinan lehu.

Rabbi yehoshua omer: meen shemone esre. may "meen shemone esre"? rav amar: meen kol beracha uveracha. ushemuel amar: "havinenu Adonai elohenu ladaat derachecha, umol et levavenu leyiratecha, vetislach lanu lihyot geulim, verachakenu mimmachovenu, vedashshenenu binot artzecha, unefutzotenu mearba tekabbetz, vehattoim al datecha yishpetu, veal harshaim tanif yadecha, veyismechu tzaddikim bevinyan irecha uvetikkun hechalecha, uvitzmichat keren ledavid avdecha uvaarichat ner leven yishay meshichecha, terem nikra atta taane. baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".
Layet ala abbaye amman dimtzalle "havinenu".
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: kol hashshana kullah mitpallel adam "havinenu", chutz mimmotzae shabbat umimmotzae yamim tovim, mippene shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat".
Matkif la rabba bar shemuel: venemra beracha reviit bifne atzmah! mi la tenan rabbi akiva omer: omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah. rabbi eliezer omer: bahodaa.

Attu kol hashshana kullah mi avdinan kerabbi akiva, dehashta name naaved?! kol hashshana kullah may tama la avdinan kerabbi akiva tamne sere takkun, teshasre la takkun, hacha name sheva takkun tamne la takkun.
Matkif la mar zutera: venichlela michlal: "havinenu Adonai elohenu hammavdil ben kodesh lechol"! kashya.

Amar rav bivi bar abbaye: kol hashshana kullah mitpallel adam "havinenu", chutz mimot haggeshamim, mippene shetztzarich lomar sheela bevirkat "hashshanim". matkif la mar zutera: venichlela michlal: "vedashshenenu binot artzecha, veten tal umatar"!
Ate leitterode. i hachi, havedala bechonen haddaat", name ate leitterode!
Amri: hatam kevan deatya bitchillat tzelota — la mitterid, hacha kevan deatya beemtza tzelota — mitterid.

Matkif la rav ashe: venemra beshomea tefilla", deamar rabbi tanchum amar rav assi: taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyayt hammetim" — machazirin oto. sheela bevirkat hashshanim — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshomea tefilla". vehavedala bechonen haddaat" — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos. taa shane.

Gufa, amar rabbi tanchum amar rav assi: taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyayt hammetim" — machazirin oto. sheela bevirkat "hashshanim" — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshomea tefilla". vehavedala bechonen haddaat" — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos.

Metivi: taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyayt hammetim" — machazirin oto. sheela bevirkat "hashshanim" — machazirin oto, vehavedala bechonen haddaat" — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos.
La kashya, ha beyachid, ha betzibbur.
Betzibbur may tama la — mishshum deshama mishsheliach tzibbur, i hachi, hay "mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshomea tefilla", "mippene sheshshomea mishsheliach tzibbur" mibbee leh.
Ella idde veidde beyachid, vela kashya: ha deiddechar kodem "shomea tefilla",
b: Ha deiddechar batar "shomea tefilla".

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rav assi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh baavoda" — chozer laavoda". nizkar bahodaa" — chozer laavoda". besim shalom" — chozer laavoda". veim siyyem — chozer larosh.
Amar rav pappa bereh derav acha bar adda: ha daamaran siyyem — chozer larosh, la amaran ella sheakar raglav, aval lo akar raglav — chozer laavoda.
Amar leh: mena lach ha? amar leh: meabba mari shemia li, veabba mari merav.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ha daamaran akar raglav chozer larosh la amaran ella sheeno ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato, aval ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato — chozer laavoda.

Ikka deamri amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ha daamaran ki lo akar raglav chozer laavoda la amaran ella sheragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato, aval im eno ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato — chozer larosh.

Rabbi eliezer omer kol haose tefillato keva vechulei: may "keva"? amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi oshaya: kol shettefillato doma alav kemassoy. verabbanan amri: kol mi sheeno omrah bilshon tachanunim. rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: kol sheeno yachol lechaddesh bah davar.
Amar rabbi zera: ana yachelna lechaddoshe ba milleta, umistefena dilma mitteridna.

Abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin deamri tarvayyhu: kol sheen mitpallel im dimdume chamma. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mitzva lehitpallel im dimdume chamma. veamar rabbi zera: may keraa — "yiraucha im shamesh velifne yareach dor dorim". layyti ala bemareva amman dimtzalle im dimdume chamma. may tama — dilma mittarfa leh shata.

Rabbi yehoshua omer hamehallech bimkom sakkana mitpallel tefilla ketzara vechulei bechol parashat haibbur: may "parashat haibbur"? amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: afillu beshaa sheatta mitmalle alehem evra keishsha ubbarah — yihyu kol tzorchehem lefanecha. ikka deamri amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: afillu beshaa shehem ovrim al divre tora — yihyu kol tzorchehem lefanecha.

Tanu rabbanan: hamehallech bimkom gedude chayya velistim mitpallel tefilla ketzara, veeze hi tefilla ketzara — rabbi eliezer omer: "ase retzoncha bashshamayim mimmaal, veten nachat ruach lireecha mittachat, vehattov beenecha ase, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".
Rabbi yehoshua omer: "shema shavat ammecha yisrael, vaase mehera bakkashatam, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".
Rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: "shema tzaakat ammecha yisrael, vaase mehera bakkashatam, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".

Acherim omrim: "tzorche ammecha yisrael merubbin vedatam ketzara. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettitten lechol echad veechad kede farnasato, ulechol geviyya ugeviyya de machsorah, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".
Amar rav huna: halacha kaacherim.

Amar leh eliyyahu lerav yehuda achu derav salla chasida: la tirtach vela tichte. la tirve vela tichte. uchesheatta yotze ladderech, himmalech bekoncha vatze. may himmalech bekoncha vatze? amar rabbi yaakov amar rav chisda: zo tefillat hadderech. veamar rabbi yaakov amar rav chisda: kol hayyotze ladderech tzarich lehitpallel tefillat hadderech.

May tefillat hadderech? "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay, shettolicheni leshalom, vetatzideni leshalom, vetismecheni leshalom, vetatztzileni mikkaf kol oyev veorev badderech, vetishlach beracha bemaase yaday, vetitteneni lechen lechesed ulerachamim beenecha uveene kol roay, baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla".
Amar abbaye: leolam

a: Lishattef inash nafsheh bahade tzibbura. hechi nema? — "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettolichenu leshalom" vechulei.

Immat metzalle? amar rabbi yaakov amar rav chisda: mishshaa shemmehallech badderech. ad kamma? amar rabbi yaakov amar rav chisda: ad parsa. vehechi metzalle la? rav chisda amar: meummad. rav sheshet amar: afillu mehallech.

Rav chisda verav sheshet havo kaazli beorcha, kam rav chisda veka metzalle. amar leh rav sheshet leshammaeh: may ka aved rav chisda? amar leh kae umetzalle. amar leh: okman name ledidi vaatzalle, "meheyot tov al tikkare ra".

May ikka ben "havinenu" litfilla ketzara? "havinenu" bae letzalloye shalosh kammayayta veshalosh batrayayta, vechi mate leveteh la bae lemehdar letzalloye, bitfilla ketzara, la bae letzalloye la shalosh kammayayta vela shalosh batrayayta, vechi mate leveteh bae lemehdar letzalloye.
Vehilcheta: "havinenu", meummad, tefilla ketzara, ben meummad ben mehallech.

Haya rochev al hachamor vechulei. tanu rabbanan: haya rochev al hachamor vehiggia zeman tefilla, im yesh lo mi sheyyochaz et chamoro — yered lematta veyitpallel, veim lav — yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel. rabbi omer: ben kach uven kach yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel, lefi sheen dato meyushshevet alav.
Amar rava, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi.
Tanu rabbanan: some umi sheeno yachol lechavven et haruchot — yechavven libbo keneged aviv shebbashshamayim, shenneemar: "vehitpallu el Adonai".

Haya omed bechutz laaretz — yechavven et libbo keneged eretz yisrael, shenneemar: "vehitpallu elecha derech artzam". haya omed beeretz yisrael — yechavven et libbo keneged yerushalayim, shenneemar: "vehitpallu el Adonai derech hair asher bacharta". haya omed birushalayim — yechavven et libbo keneged bet hammikdash, shenneemar: "vehitpallu el habbayit hazze". haya omed bevet hammikdash — yechavven et libbo keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim, shenneemar: "vehitpallu el hammakom hazze". haya omed bevet kodshe hakkodashim — yechavven et libbo keneged bet hakkapporet. haya omed achore bet hakkapporet — yire atzmo keillu lifne hakkapporet. nimtza omed bammizrach machazir panav lammaarav. bammaarav machazir panav lammizrach. baddarom — machazir panav latztzafon. batztzafon — machazir panav laddarom. nimtzeu kol yisrael mechavvevnin et libbam lemakom echad.
Amar rabbi avin, veittema rabbi avina: may keraa — "kemigdal david tzavvarech banuy letalpiyyot" — tel shekkol piyyot ponim bo.
Avu dishmuel velevi, ki havo bau lemippak leorcha, havo mekaddemi umetzalli, vechi hava mate zeman keriat shema karu.

Keman — ki hay tanna. detanya: hishkim latzet ladderech, meviin lo shofar vetokea, lulav umenanea, megilla vekore bah, uchesheyyaggia zeman keriat shema — kore. hishkim leshev bakkaron o bisfina — mitpallel, uchesheyyaggia zeman keriat shema — kore.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: ben kach uven kach kore keriat shema umitpallel, kede sheyyismoch geulla litfilla.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar tefilla meummad adif, umar savar mismach geulla litfilla adif.
Marimar umar zutera havo mechannefi be asra beshabbeta derigla umetzallu, vahadar nafki lefirka.

Rav ashe metzalle bahade tzibbura beyachid, meyushshav. ki hava ate leveteh, hadar umetzalle meummad. amri leh rabbanan: velaaved mar kemarimar umar zutera! amar lehu: tericha li milleta. velaaved mar kaavu dishmuel velevi! amar lehu: la chazena lehu lerabbanan kashshishe minnan deavdi hachi.

Mishna rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: en tefillat hammusafin ella bechever ir. vachachamim omrim: bechever ir veshello bechever ir. rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo: kol makom sheyyesh sham chever ir — yachid patur mittefillat hammusafin.
Gemara rabbi yehuda hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu yachid shello bechever ir, tanna kamma savar patur. verabbi yehuda savar chayyayv.

Amar rav huna bar chinnana amar rav chiyyay bar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya. amar leh rav chiyyay bar avin: shappir kaamrat, deamar shemuel: mimay la metzallena tzelota demusafin beyachid
b: Binhardea, levar mehahu yoma daata pulemusa demalka lemata, veitteridu rabbanan vela tzallo, vetzalli li beyachid, vahavay yachid shello bechever ir.

Yatev rabbi chanina kara kammeh derabbi yannay, veyatev vekaamar: halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya. amar leh: puk kere keraaych levara, deen halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ani raiti et rabbi yannay detzalli vahadar tzalli. amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: vedilma meikkara la kavvevn dateh ulevassof kavvevn dateh. amar leh: chazi man gavra rabba dekamashed aleh.
Rabbi amme verabbi assi af al gav dahavo lehu telesar be chenishta bitverya la havo metzallu ella bene ammude, hecha dahavo garsi.

Ittemar, rav yitzchak bar avdimi mishshum rabbenu amar: halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya. rabbi chiyyay bar abba tzalli vahadar tzalli. amar leh rabbi zera: may tama aved mar hachi? illema mishshum dela kavvevn mar dateh, vehaamar rabbi eliezer: leolam yamod adam et atzmo, im yachol lechavven et libbo — yitpallel, veim lav — al yitpallel. ella dela adkar mar deresh yarcha.

Vehatanya taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh, bearvit — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshacharit. beshacharit — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah bemusafin. bemusafin — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah bemincha.
Amar leh: lav ittemar ala amar rabbi yochanan betzibbur shanu.
Kamma yishhe ben tefilla litfilla? rav huna verav chisda. chad amar: kede shettitchonen dato alav, vechad amar: kede shettitcholel dato alav.
Man deamar "kede shettitchonen dato alav", dichtiv: "vaetchannan el Adonai". uman deamar "kede shettitcholel dato alav", dichtiv: "vaychal moshe".
Amar rav anan amar rav: taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh arvit — en machazirin oto, lefi sheen bet din mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bayyom.
Amar ammemar: mistabbera milleta derav bechodesh male. aval bechodesh chaser — machazirin oto.
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar: mikkede rav tama kaamar, ma li chaser uma li male?! ella la shena.
Haderan alach tefillat hashshachar

Mishna en omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch koved rosh. chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat, umitpallelin, kede sheyyechavvevnu libbam laavihem shebbashshamayim. afillu hammelech shoel bishlomo — lo yeshivennu, vaafillu nachash karuch al akevo — lo yafsik.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi elazar: deamar kera "vehi marat nafesh".
Mimmay? dilma channa shane, dahavat merira libba tuva.
Ella amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, mehacha: "vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha eshtachave el hechal kodshecha beyiratecha".
Mimmay? dilma david shane, dahava metzaar nafsheh berachame tuva. ella amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, mehacha: "hishtachavu laAdonai behaderat kodesh": al tikre "behaderat" ella "becherdat".
Mimmay? dilma leolam ema lecha, "haderat" mammash. ki ha derav yehuda hava metzayyen nafsheh, vahadar metzalle. ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mehacha: "ivdu et Adonai beyira vegilu birada".
May "vegilu birada"? amar rav adda bar matna amar rabba: bimkom gila sham tehe reada.
Abbaye hava yatev kammeh derabba chazyeh dahava ka vadach tuva. amar "vegilu birada" ketiv!
Amar leh: ana tefillin mannachna.
Rabbi yirmeya hava yatev kammeh derabbi zera. chazyeh dahava ka vadach tuva amar leh: "bechol etzev yihye motar" ketiv?
Amar leh: ana tefillin mannachna.
Mar bereh deravina avad hillula livreh, chazanhu lerabbanan dahavo kavadchi tuva.

a: Ayyeyti kasa demokra bat arba mea zuzi, vetabbar kammayhu, veiatzivu.
Rav ashe avad hillula livreh, chazanhu lerabbanan dahavo ka vadchi tuva. ayyeyti kasa dezuggita chivvarta, vetabbar kammayhu, veiatzivu.

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav hamenuna zute behillula demar bereh deravina: lishre lan mar. amar lehu: vay lan, demitnan. vay lan, demitnan. amri leh: anan ma naane batrach? amar lehu: he tora, vehe mitzva demaggenu alan.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: asur leadam sheyyemalle sechok piv baolam hazze, shenneemar: "az yimmale sechok pinu uleshonenu rinna". ematay, bizman sheyyomru vaggoyim higdil Adonai laasot im elle". amru alav al resh lakish shemmiyyamav lo mille sechok piv baolam hazze, mikki shama merabbi yochanan rabbeh.
Tanu rabbanan: en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch din, velo mittoch devar halacha, ella mittoch halacha pesuka.
Vehechi dame halacha pesuka?
Amar abbaye: ki ha derabbi zera, deamar rabbi zera: benot yisrael hechemiru al atzman, sheafillu root tippat dam kechardal yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim.
Rava amar, ki ha derav hoshaya, deamar rav hoshaya: maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah, kede shettehe behemto ochelet, ufetura min hammaaser.
Veibbaet ema, ki ha derav huna, deamar rav huna, amar rabbi zeera: hammakkiz dam bevehemat kodashim, asur bahanaa, umoalin bo.
Rabbanan avdi kematnitin, rav ashe aved kevarayyta.

Tanu rabbanan: en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch atzvut, velo mittoch atzlut, velo mittoch sechok, velo mittoch sicha, velo mittoch kallut rosh, velo mittoch devarim betelim, ella mittoch simcha shel mitzva.

Vechen lo yippater adam mechavero lo mittoch sicha, velo mittoch sechok, velo mittoch kallut rosh, velo mittoch devarim betelim, ella mittoch devar halacha. shekken matzinu banneviim harishonim, shessiyyemu divrehem bedivre shevach vetanchumim.
Vechen tena mari bar bereh derav huna bereh derabbi yirmeya bar abba: al yippater adam mechavero ella mittoch devar halacha, shemmittoch kach zochrehu.
Ki ha derav kahana alveyeh lerav shimi bar ashe mippum nahara ad be tzinyata devavel. ki meta lehatam amar leh: mar, vadday deamri inashe: hane tzinyata devavel itanhu meadam harishon vead hasheta?

Amar leh: adkartan milleta derabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "beeretz asher lo avar bah ish velo yashav adam sham", vechi meachar delo avar heach yashav? ella lomar lach kol eretz sheggazar aleha adam harishon leyishshuv — nityashsheva. vechol eretz shello gazar aleha adam harishon leyishshuv — lo nityashsheva.
Rav mardechay alveyeh lerav shimi bar ashe mehageronya, vead be chefe. veamri la ad be dura.
Tanu rabbanan: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo lashshamayim. abba shaul omer: siman laddavar, "tachin libbam takshiv oznecha".

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda: kach haya minhago shel rabbi akiva, keshehaya mitpallel im hatztzibbur — haya mekatztzer veole, mippene torach tzibbur. ucheshehaya mitpallel beno leven atzmo — adam mannicho bezavit zo, umotzo bezavit acheret. vechol kach lamma? mippene keriot vehishtachavayot.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: leolam yitpallel adam bevayit sheyyesh bo challonot, shenneemar: "vechavvin petichan leh vegomer".
Yachol yitpallel adam kol hayyom kullo — kevar meforash al yede daniel: "vezimnin telata vegomer".
Yachol mishshebba laggola huchalla — kevar neemar: "di hava aved min kadmat dena".
Yachol yitpallel adam lechol ruach sheyyirtze — talmud lomar: "(lokovel) [neged] yerushelem".
Yachol yehe kollan bevat achat — kevar meforash al yede david, dichtiv: "erev vavoker vetzohorayim vegomer".
Yachol yashmia kolo bitfillato — kevar meforash al yede channa, shenneemar: "vekolah lo yishshamea".

Yachol yishal adam tzerachav veachar kach yitpallel — kevar meforash al yede shelomo, shenneemar: "lishmoa el harinna veel hattefilla". "rinna" zo tefilla, "tefilla" zo bakkasha. en omer devar bakkasha achar "emet veyatztziv". aval achar hattefilla, afillu keseder vidduy shel yom hakkippurim omer.
Ittemar name, amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: af al pi sheamru shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla", im ba lomar achar tefillato — afillu keseder shel yom hakkippurim omer.

Amar rav hamenuna: kamma hilcheta gibbaravota ikka lemishma mehane kerae dechanna. "vechanna hi medabberet al libbah" — mikkan lammitpallel tzarich sheyyechavven libbo. "rak sefateha naot" — mikkan lammitpallel sheyyachtoch bisfatav. "vekolah lo yishshamea" — mikkan sheasur lehagebiah kolo bitfillato. "vayyachsheveha eli leshikkora" — mikkan sheshshikkor asur lehitpallel.
"Vayyomer eleha eli ad matay tishtakkarin vegomer". amar rabbi elazar: mikkan laroe bachavero
b: Davar sheeno hagun, tzarich lehochicho. "vattaan channa vattomer lo adoni". amar ulla veittema rabbi yose berabbi chanina: amara leh: lo adon atta bedavar ze, velo ruach hakkodesh shora alecha, sheatta choshdeni bedavar ze.
Ikka deamri, hachi amara leh: lo adon atta? lav ikka shechina veruach hakkodesh gabbach, sheddantani lechaf chova velo dantani lechaf zechut? mi la yadat deishsha keshat ruach anochi?!
"Veyayin veshechar lo shatiti". amar rabbi elazar: mikkan lannechshad bedavar sheen bo, shetztzarich lehodio.

"Al titten et amatcha lifne bat beliyyaal". amar rabbi elazar: mikkan leshikkor shemmitpallel, keillu oved avoda zara. ketiv hacha: "lifne bat beliyyaal", uchetiv hatam: "yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal mikkirbecha". ma lehallan avoda zara, af kan avoda zara.

"Vayyaan eli vayyomer lechi leshalom", amar rabbi elazar: mikkan lachoshed et chavero bedavar sheen bo, shetztzarich lefayyeyso. velo od, ella shetztzarich levarcho. shenneemar "velohe yisrael yitten et shelatech".

"Vattiddor neder vattomar Adonai tzevaot", amar rabbi elazar: miyyom shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo, lo haya adam shekkerao lehakkadosh baruch hu "tzevaot", ad shebbata channa ukeraattu "tzevaot".
Amra channa lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, mikkol tzive tzevaot shebbarata beolamcha kashe beenecha shettitten li ben echad?

Mashal lamma haddavar dome — lemelech basar vadam sheasa seuda laavadav. ba ani echad veamad al happetach, amar lahem: tenu li perusa achat! velo hishgichu alav. dachak venichnas etzel hammelech. amar lo: adoni hammelech, mikkol seuda sheasita kashe beenecha litten li perusa echat?!
