"Im rao tire", amar rabbi elazar: amra channa lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, "im rao" — mutav, veim lav — "tire".
Elech veestatter bifne elkana baali, vechevan demistattarna mashku li me sota, vei atta ose toratcha pelaster, shenneemar "venikketa venizrea zara".

Hanicha leman deamar: im hayta akara — nifkedet, shappir, ella leman deamar, im hayta yoledet betzaar yoledet berevach, nekevot yoledet zecharim shechorim yoledet levanim ketzarim yoledet arukkim, may ikka lememar?

Detanya: "venikketa venizrea zara" — melammed sheim hayta akara — nifkedet, divre rabbi yishmael. amar leh rabbi akiva: im ken, yelchu kol haakarot kullan veyistatteru, vezo shello kilkela — nifkedet. ella melammed sheim hayta yoledet betzaar — yoledet berevach, ketzarim — yoledet arukkim, shechorim — yoledet levanim, echad — yoledet shenayim.
May "im rao tire" — dibbera tora kilshon bene adam.
"Booni amatecha". "al tishkach et amatecha". "venatatta laamatcha".

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: shalosh amatot hallalu lamma? — amra channa lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, shelosha bidke mita barata baishsha, veamri la: shelosha divke mita. veellu hen: nidda, vechalla vehadelakat hanner. kelum avarti al achat mehen?! —
"Venatatta laamatcha zera anashim".

May "zera anashim"? amar rav: gavra beguverin. ushemuel amar: zera shemmosheach shene anashim, uman innun — shaul vedavid. verabbi yochanan amar: zera sheshshakul kishne anashim, uman innun — moshe veaharon. shenneemar: "moshe veaharon bechohanav ushemuel bekore shemo". verabbanan amri: "zera anashim" — zera shemmuvela ben anashim.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar lo aroch velo gutz, velo katan velo allam, velo tzachor velo gichor, velo chacham velo tippesh.
"Ani haishsha hannitztzevet immecha baze", amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mikkan sheasur leshev betoch arba ammot shel tefilla.

"El hannaar hazze hitpallalti". amar rabbi elazar: shemuel more halacha lifne rabbo haya. shenneemar: "vayyishchatu et happar vayyaviu et hannaar el eli". mishshum devayyishchatu et happar" heviu hannaar el eli?

Ella, amar lahen eli: kiru kohen, lete velishchot. chazanhu shemuel dahavo mehadderi batar kohen lemishchat, amar lehu: lema lechu leahdore batar kohen lemishchat? shechita bezar keshera! ayytuhu lekammeh deeli. amar leh: mena lach ha? amar leh: mi ketiv "veshachat hakkohen"?! "vehikrivu hakkohanim" ketiv, mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna, mikkan lashshechita shekkeshera bezar.

Amar leh: memar shappir ka amrat, mihu more halacha bifne rabbach at, vechol hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyayv mita. atya channa veka tzavvcha kammeh: "ani haishsha hannitztzevet immecha baze vegomer". amar la: shivki li deeensheh, uveena rachame, veyahev lach rabba minneh. amara leh: "el hannaar hazze hitpallalti".

"Vechanna hi medabberet al libbah". amar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: al iske libbah. amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kol ma shebbarata baishsha, lo barata davar echad levattala: enayim lirot, veoznayim lishmoa, chotem lehariach, pe ledabber, yadayim laasot bahem melacha, raglayim lehallech bahen, daddim lehanik bahen. daddim hallalu shennatatta al libbi lamma? lo lehanik bahen?! ten li ben, veanik bahen.
Veamar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: kol hayyoshev betaanit beshabbat korim lo gezar dino shel shivim shana. veaf al pi chen chozrin venifrain mimmennu din oneg shabbat.
May takkanteh? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: littev taanita letaanita.
Veamar rabbi elazar: channa heticha devarim kelappe mala. shenneemar "vetitpallel al Adonai", melammed sheheticha devarim kelappe mala.

Veamar rabbi elazar: eliyyahu hetiach devarim kelappe mala, shenneemar: "veatta hasibbota et libbam achorannit". amar rabbi shemuel bar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu vehoda lo leeliyyahu,

a: Dichtiv: "vaasher hareoti".
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: ilmale shalosh mikraot hallalu nitmottu raglehem shel sone yisrael.
Chad dichtiv: "vaasher hareoti", vechad dichtiv: "hinne chachomer beyad hayyotzer ken attem beyadi bet yisrael", vechad dichtiv: "vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar".
Rav pappa amar mehacha: "veet ruchi etten bekirbechem veasiti et asher bechukkay telechu".
Veamar rabbi elazar: moshe hetiach devarim kelappe mala. shenneemar: "vayyitpallel moshe el Adonai" al tikre "el Adonai", ella "al Adonai".
Shekken deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov korin laalfin ayynin, velaayynin alfin.
Deve rabbi yannay amri, mehacha: "vedi zahav".

May "vedi zahav"? amri deve rabbi yannay: kach amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, bishvil kesef vezahav shehishpata lahem leyisrael, ad sheamru "day" — hu garam sheasu et haegel.
Amri deve rabbi yannay: en ari nohem mittoch kuppa shel teven ella mittoch kuppa shel basar.
Amar rabbi oshaya: mashal leadam shehayta lo para kechusha uvaalat evarim, heechilah karshinin vehayta mevaetet bo. amar lah: mi garam lich shettehe mevaetet bi — ella karshinin sheheechaltich.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mashal leadam echad shehaya lo ben. hirchitzo vesacho, veheechilo vehishkahu, vetala lo kis al tzavvaro, vehoshivo al petach shel zonot. ma yaase oto habben shello yecheta?!

Amar rav acha bereh derav huna amar rav sheshet: hayeynu deamri inashe: mele kereseh zene bishe. shenneemar: "kemaritam vayyisbau savu vayyarom libbam al ken shechechuni". rav nachman amar: mehacha: "veram levavecha veshachachta et Adonai". verabbanan amri, mehacha: "veachal vesava vedashen ufana".

Vei baet ema mehacha: "vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat". amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu vehoda lo lemoshe, shenneemar: "vechesef hirbeti lahem vezahav asu labbaal".

"Vaydabber Adonai el moshe lech red". may "lech red"? amar rabbi elazar: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe, red miggedullatcha! kelum natatti lecha gedulla ella bishvil yisrael. veachshav yisrael chatu — atta lamma li? miyyad tashash kocho shel moshe, velo haya lo koach ledabber. vechevan sheamar "heref mimmenni veashmidem", amar moshe: davar ze taluy bi! miyyad amad venitchazzek bitfilla, uvikkesh rachamim.

Mashal lemelech shekkaas al beno, vehaya makkehu makka gedola. vehaya ohavo yoshev lefanav, umityare lomar lo davar. amar hammelech: ilmale ohavi ze sheyyoshev lefanay — haragticha. amar: davar ze taluy bi. miyyad amad vehitztzilo.

"Veatta hannicha li veyichar appi vahem vaachallem veeese otcha legoy gadol vegomer". amar rabbi avahu: ilmale mikra katuv, i efshar leomro. melammed shettefaso moshe lehakkadosh baruch hu, keadam shehu tofes et chavero bevigdo, veamar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, en ani mannichacha ad shettimchol vetislach lahem.

"Veeese otcha legoy gadol vegomer". amar rabbi elazar: amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, uma kisse shel shalosh raglayim eno yachol laamod lefanecha bishat kasech. kisse shel regel echad — al achat kamma vechamma!
Velo od ella sheyyesh bi boshet panim meavotay, achshav yomru: reu parnas sheheemid alehem. bikkesh gedulla leatzmo, velo bikkesh alehem rachamim.

"Vaychal moshe et pene Adonai", amar rabbi elazar: melammed sheamad moshe bitfilla lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, ad shehechelahu. verava amar: ad shehefer lo nidro. ketiv hacha: "vaychal", uchetiv hatam: "lo yachel devaro", veamar mar: hu eno mechel, aval acherim mechillin lo.
Ushemuel amar: melammed shemmasar atzmo lemita alehem. shenneemar: "veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha".
Amar rava amar rav yitzchak: melammed shehuchala alehem middat rachamim.
Verabbanan amri: melammed sheamar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam! chullin hu lecha measot kaddavar hazze.

"Vaychal moshe et pene Adonai", tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: melammed sheamad moshe bitfilla lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ad sheachazattu achilu. may achilu? amar rabbi elazar: esh shel atzamot. may esh shel atzamot? amar abbaye: ishshata degarme.

"Zechor leavraham leyitzchak uleyisrael avadecha asher nishbata lahem bach". may "bach"? amar rabbi elazar: amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ilmale nishbata lahem bashshamayim uvaaretz, hayiti omer: keshem sheshshamayim vaaretz betelim — kach shevuatcha betela. veachshav shennishbata lahem beshimcha haggadol, ma shimcha haggadol chay vekayyaym leolam uleolme olamim — kach shevuatcha kayyemet leolam uleolme olamim.
"Vattedabber alehem arbe et zarachem kechochve hashshamayim vechol haaretz hazzot asher amarti", hay "asher amarti", "asher amarta" mibbee leh!

Amar rabbi elazar: ad kan divre talmid, mikkan veelach — divre harav. verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ellu vaellu divre talmid, ella kach amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, devarim sheamarta li "lech emor lahem leyisrael" bishmi, halachti veamarti lahem bishmecha. achshav ma ani omer lahem?
"Mibbilti yecholet Adonai": yachol Adonai mibbee leh.

Amar rabbi elazar: amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, achshav yomru ummot haolam tashash kocho kinkeva, veeno yachol lehatztzil. amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: vahalo kevar rau nissim ugevurot sheasiti lahem al hayyam. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, adayin yesh lahem lomar: lemelech echad yachol laamod, lishloshim veechad melachim eno yachol laamod.
Amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu vehoda lo lemoshe, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai salachti kidvarecha". tane deve rabbi yishmael: kidvarecha, atidim ummot haolam lomar ken.
Ashre talmid sherabbo mode lo.
"Veulam chay ani", amar rava amar rav yitzchak: melammed sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe, hecheyitani bidvarecha.

Darash rabbi simlay: leolam yesadder adam shivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu, veachar kach yitpallel. menalan? — mimmoshe, dichtiv: "vaetchannan el Adonai baet hahi". uchetiv: "Adonai elohim atta hachillota lehareot et avdecha et godlecha veet yadcha hachazaka asher mi el bashshamayim uvaaretz asher yaase chemaasecha vechigvurotecha". uchetiv batreh "ebera na veere et haaretz hattova vegomer".
Siman: maasim, tzedaka, korban, kohen, taanit, minal, barzel.
b: Amar rabbi elazar: gedola tefilla yoter mimmaasim tovim, sheen lecha gadol bemaasim tovim yoter mimmoshe rabbenu, af al pi chen lo naana ella bitfilla. shenneemar: "al tosef dabber elay" usemich leh: "ale rosh happisga".
Veamar rabbi elazar: gedola taanit yoter min hatztzedaka. may tama — ze begufo, veze bemamono.
Veamar rabbi elazar: gedola tefilla yoter min hakkarbanot, shenneemar "lamma li rov zivchechem", uchetiv: "uvefarischem kappechem".
Amar rabbi yochanan: kol kohen sheharag et hannefesh — lo yissa et kappav, shenneemar: "yedechem damim maleu".

Veamar rabbi elazar: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash ninalu shaare tefilla, shenneemar: "gam ki ezak vaashavvea satam tefillati". veaf al pi sheshshaare tefilla ninalu, shaare dima lo ninalu, shenneemar: "shima tefillati Adonai veshavati haazina el dimati al techerash".
Rava la gezar taanita beyoma deeva, mishshum shenneemar "sakkota veanan lach meavor tefilla".

Veamar rabbi elazar: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nifseka chomat barzel ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim, shenneemar: "veatta kach lecha machavat barzel venatatta otah kir barzel bencha uven hair".

Amar rabbi chanin amar rabbi chanina: kol hammaarich bitfillato, en tefillato chozeret rekam. mena lan — mimmoshe rabbenu, shenneemar: "vaetpallel el Adonai", uchetiv batreh: "vayyishma Adonai elay gam bappaam hahi".

Ini?! veha amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammaarich bitfillato umeayyen bah — sof ba lide keev lev, shenneemar: "tochelet memushshacha machala lev". may takkanteh — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "veetz chayyim taava vaa", veen etz chayyim ella tora, shenneemar: "etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah". la kashya, ha demaarech umeayyen ba. ha demaarech vela meayyen ba
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: im raa adam shehitpallel velo naana — yachzor veyitpallel. shenneemar: "kavve el Adonai chazak veyaametz libbecha vekavve el Adonai".
Tanu rabbanan: arbaa tzerichin chizzuk, veellu hen: tora, umaasim tovim, tefilla, vederech eretz.
Tora umaasim tovim minnayin? — shenneemar: "rak chazak veematz meod lishmor velaasot kechol hattora", "chazak" — battora, "veematz" — bemaasim tovim.
Tefilla minnayin? — shenneemar "kavve el Adonai chazak veyaametz libbecha vekavve el Adonai".
Derech eretz minnayin? — shenneemar "chazak venitchazzak bead ammenu vegomer".

"Vattomer tziyyon azavani Adonai vaAdonai shechechani". hayeynu azuva, hayeynu shechucha? amar resh lakish: amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, adam nose ishsha al ishto rishona, zocher maase harishona. atta azavtani ushechachtani.

Amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu: bitti, shenem asar mazzalot barati barakia, veal kol mazzal umazzal barati lo sheloshim chayil, veal kol chayil vechayil barati lo sheloshim ligyon, veal kol ligyon veligyon barati lo sheloshim rahaton, veal kol rahaton verahaton barati lo sheloshim keraton, veal kol keraton ukeraton barati lo sheloshim gastera, veal kol gastera vegastera taliti bo shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha alfe ribbo kochavim keneged yemot hachamma. vechullan lo barati ella bishvilech, veat amart "azavtani" ushechachtani"?!

"Hatishkach ishsha ulah", amar hakkadosh baruch hu: kelum eshkach olot elim ufitre rechamim shehikravt lefanay bammidbar?! amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hoil veen shichcha lifne kisse chevodecha, shemma lo tishkach li maase haegel? amar lah: "gam elle tishkachna".
Amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hoil veyesh shichcha lifne kisse chevodecha, shemma tishkach li maase sinay? amar lah: "veanochi lo eshkachech".
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar amar rav oshaya: may dichtiv "gam elle tishkachna" — ze maase haegel, "veanochi lo eshkachech" — ze maase sinay.
Chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat:
Mena hane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar kera: "ashre yoshve vetecha".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammitpallel tzarich lishhot shaa achat achar tefillato, shenneemar: "ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha".

Tanya name hachi: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyishhe shaa achat kodem tefillato, veshaa achat achar tefillato. kodem tefillato, minnayin? shenneemar: "ashre yoshve vetecha". leachar tefillato minnayin? — dichtiv: "ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha".

Tanu rabbanan: chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat, umitpallelin shaa achat, vechozrin veshohin shaa achat. vechi meachar sheshshohin tesha shaot bayyom bitfilla, toratan heach mishtammeret, umelachtam heach naaset?
Ella mittoch shechasidim hem — toratam mishtammeret, umelachtan mitbarechet.
Afillu hammelech shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu.
Amar rav yosef, lo shanu ella lemalche yisrael, aval lemalche ummot haolam — posek.
Metivi: hammitpallel veraa annas ba kenegdo, raa karon ba kenegdo — lo yehe mafsik, ella mekatztzer veole!
La kashya, ha deefshar lekatztzer (yekatztzer. veim lav — posek).

Tanu rabbanan: maase bechasid echad shehaya mitpallel badderech. ba hegmon echad venatan lo shalom, velo hechzir lo shalom. himtin lo ad shessiyyem tefillato. leachar shessiyyem tefillato, amar lo: reka, vahalo katuv betoratchem "rak hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha", uchetiv "venishmartem meod lenafshotechem". keshennatatti lecha shalom lamma lo hechzarta li shalom? im hayiti chotech roshcha besayif, mi haya tovea et damcha miyyadi?!
Amar lo: hameten li ad sheafayyescha bidvarim. amar lo: illu hayita omed lifne melech basar vadam, uva chavercha venatan lecha shalom — hayita

a: Machazir lo?! amar lo: lav. veim hayita machazir lo, ma hayu osim lecha? amar lo: hayu chotchim et roshi besayif. amar lo: vahalo devarim kal vachomer, uma atta shehayita omed lifne melech basar vadam, shehayyom kan umachar bakkever — kach ani shehayiti omed lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu, shehu chay vekayyaym laad uleolme olamim — al achat kamma vechamma.
Miyyad nitpayyes oto hegmon, veniftar oto chasid leveto leshalom.
Afillu nachash karuch al akevo, lo yafsik. amar rav sheshet: lo shanu ella nachash. aval akrav — posek.
Metivi: nafal legov arayot — en meidin alav shemmet. nafal lachafira melea nechashim veakrabbim — meidin alav shemmet!
Shane hatam, deaggav itztza mazzeki.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: raa shevavrim — posek. detane rav hoshaya: marchikin mishshor tam chamishshim amma, umishshor muad — kimlo enav.
Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: resh tora bedikkula — selek leagra ushedi darga mittutach. amar shemuel: hane mille beshor shachor uveyome nisan, mippene shehassatan merakked lo ben karnav.

Tanu rabbanan: maase bemakom echad shehaya arvad, vehaya mazzik et habberiyyot. bau vehodiu lo lerabbi chanina ben dosa. amar lahem: hareu li et choro! heruhu et choro. natan akevo al pi hachor, yatza uneshacho — umet oto arvad.
Netalo al ketefo vehevio levet hammidrash. amar lahem: reu banay, en arvad memit, ella hachet memit.
Beotah shaa amru: oy lo laadam sheppaga bo arvad, veoy lo laarvad sheppaga bo rabbi chanina ben dosa.
Mishna mazkirin gevurot geshamim bitchiyyayt hammetim, usheela bevirkat hashshanim, vehavedala bechonen haddaat. rabbi akiva omer: omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah. rabbi eliezer omer: bahodaa.
Gemara mazkirin gevurot geshamim: may tama?
Amar rav yosef: mittoch sheshshekula kitchiyyayt hammetim lefichach kevauha bitchiyyayt hammetim.
Usheela bevirkat hashshanim: may tama?
Amar rav yosef: mittoch shehi parnasa, lefichach kevauha bevirkat parnasa.
Havedala bechonen haddaat": may tama?
Amar rav yosef: mittoch shehi chachma, kevauha bevirkat chachma. verabbanan amri: mittoch shehi chol, lefichach kevauha bevirkat chol.
Amar rav amme: gedola dea, shennittena bitchillat beracha shel chol.
Veamar rav amme: gedola dea, shennittena ben shete otiyyot, shenneemar "ki el deot Adonai". vechol mi sheen bo dea — asur lerachem alav, shenneemar: "ki lo am binot hu al ken lo yerachamennu osehu".
Amar rabbi elazar: gadol mikdash shennittan ben shete otiyyot, shenneemar: "paalta Adonai mikkedash Adonai".
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo dea keillu nivna bet hammikdash beyamav. dea nittena ben shete otiyyot, mikdash nittan ben shete otiyyot.
Matkif la rav acha karchinaa: ella meatta, gedola nekama shennittena ben shete otiyyot, shenneemar "el nekamot Adonai"!

Amar leh: in, bemilleta miha gedola hi. vehayeynu deamar ulla shete nekamot hallalu lamma? achat letova, veachat leraa. letova — dichtiv: "hofia mehar paran". leraa — dichtiv: "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia".
Rabbi akiva omer: omrah beracha reviit kulei.
Amar leh rav shemen bar abba lerabbi yochanan: mikkedi anshe keneset haggedola tikkenu lahem leyisrael berachot utefillot, kedushshot vehavedalot. nechze hechan takkun.
Amar leh: battechilla kevauha battefilla. heeshiru — kevauha al hakkos. heenu — chazru ukevauha battefilla. vehem amru: hammavdil battefilla tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos.

Ittemar name: amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: anshe keneset haggedola tikkenu lahem leyisrael berachot utefillot, kedushshot vehavedalot. battechilla kevauha battefilla. heeshiru — kevauha al hakkos. chazru veheenu — kevauha battefilla. vehem amru: hammavdil battefilla — tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos.
Ittemar name: rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hammavdil battefilla — tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos.

Amar rava, umotvinan ashshematin: taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyayt hammetim usheela bevirkat hashshanim — machazirin oto, vehavedala bechonen haddaat" — en machazirin oto, mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos.
La tema: "mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos", ella ema: "mippene sheomrah al hakkos".

Ittemar name, amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet: shaal rabbi yose et rabbi yochanan betzaydan, veamri la rabbi shimon ben yaakov demin tzor et rabbi yochanan, vaana shemait: hammavdil battefilla, tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos, o lo? vaamar leh: tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos.
Ibbaya lehu: hammavdil al hakkos, mahu sheyyavdil battefilla?

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kal vachomer mittefilla. uma tefilla deikkar takkanta hi, amri: hammavdil battefilla — tzarich sheyyavdil al hakkos. hammavdil al hakkos, delav ikkar takkanta hi — lo kol shekken!
Tane rav acha aricha kammeh derav chinnana: hammavdil battefilla meshubbach yoter mimmi sheyyavdil al hakkos. veim hivdil bezo uvazo — yanuchu lo berachot al rosho.

Ha gufa kashya: amrat hammavdil battefilla meshubbach yoter mimmi sheyyavdil al hakkos, alma tefilla lechuda saggi. vahadar tane im hivdil bezo uvazo — yanuchu lo berachot al rosho. vechevan denafek leh bachada — ippetar, vehavya beracha sheenah tzericha, veamar rav veittema resh lakish, veamri la rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: kol hamevarech beracha sheenah tzericha — over mishshum "lo tissa"!
Ella, ema hachi: im hivdil bezo velo hivdil bazo — yanuchu lo berachot al rosho.
Bea minneh rav chisda merav sheshet: taa bezo uvazo, mahu? amar leh: taa bezo uvazo — chozer larosh.
b: Amar leh ravina lerava: hilcheta may? amar leh, ki kiddush: ma kiddush af al gav dimkaddesh bitzlota mekaddesh akkasa, af havedala name, af al gav demavdel bitzlota mavdel akkasa.
Rabbi eliezer omer: behodaa".

Rabbi zera hava rechiv chamara, hava ka shakel veazel rabbi chiyyay bar avin batreh. amar leh: vadday deamritu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan, halacha kerabbi eliezer beyom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat? amar leh: in.
Halacha — michlal difligi?
Vela peligi? veha peligi rabbanan.
Emar difligi rabbanan bishar yemot hashshana, beyom tov shechal lihyot achar hashshabbat mi peligi?
Veha pelig rabbi akiva!

Attu kol hashshana kullah mi avdinan kerabbi akiva, dehashta neku venaaved kevoteh?! kol hashshana kullah may tama la avdinan kerabbi akiva — detamne sere takkun, teshasre la takkun. hacha name, shav takkun tamne la takkun.
Amar leh: lav "halacha" ittemar, ella "mattin" ittemar.
Deittemar, rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi amar mishshum rabbenu: halacha, veamri la: mattin.
Rabbi yochanan amar: modim. verabbi chiyyay bar abba amar: nirin.
Amar rabbi zera: nekot derabbi chiyyay bar abba bidach, dedayek vegamar shemata mippumma demara shappir kerachava defumebdita.
Deamar rachava amar rabbi yehuda: har habbayit setav kaful haya, vehaya setav lefanim missetav.
Amar rav yosef: ana la hay yadana vela hay yadana, ella midderav ushemuel yadana, detakkinu lan marganita bevavel.

"Vattodienu Adonai elohenu et mishpete tzidkecha vattelammedenu laasot chukke retzonecha, vattanchilenu zemanne sason vechagge nedava, vattorishenu kedushshat shabbat uchevod moed vachagigat haregel. ben kedushshat shabbat likdushshat yom tov hivdalta, veet yom hashshevii mishsheshet yeme hammaase kiddashta. hivdalta vekiddashta et ammecha yisrael bikdushshatecha. vattitten lanu vechulei".
Mishna haomer: "al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha", veal tov yizzacher shemecha", "modim, modim" — meshattekin oto.

Gemara bishlama, "modim, modim" meshattekin oto — mishshum demechze kishte rashuyot. veal tov yizzacher shemecha" name, mashma al hattova velo al haraa, utenan: chayyayv adam levarech al haraa keshem shemmevarech al hattova. ella "al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha" may tama?

Peligi ba tere amorae bemareva, rabbi yose bar avin verabbi yose bar zevida: chad amar: mippene shemmetil kina bemaase bereshit. vechad amar: mippene sheose middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu rachamim, veenan ella gezerot.

Hahu dinchet kammeh derabba vaamar: atta chasta al kan tzippor, atta chus verachem alenu. amar rabba: kamma yada hay tzureba merabbanan leratztzoye lemareh! amar leh abbaye: veha meshattekin oto tenan!
Verabba name, lechaddode abbaye hu devae.
Hahu dinchet kammeh derabbi chanina, amar "hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora vehaaddir vehaizzuz vehayyarouy, hechazak vehaammitz vehavvadday vehannichbad".

Himtin lo ad desayyem. ki sayyem amar leh: sayyemtinhu lechullehu shivche demarach?! lema li kulle hay? anan, hane telat deamrinan i lav deamrinhu moshe rabbenu beorayyta, vaato anshe keneset haggedola vetakkeninhu bitfilla — la havenan yecholin lememar lehu, veat amrat kulle hay veazlat! mashal lemelech basar vadam shehayu lo elef alafim dinre zahav, vehayu mekallesin oto beshel kesef. vahalo genay hu lo!
Veamar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim, chutz miyyirat shamayim. shenneemar: "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira".

Attu yirat shamayim milleta zutarta hi? vehaamar rabbi chanina mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: en lo lehakkadosh baruch hu bevet genazav ella otzar shel yirat shamayim, shenneemar "yirat Adonai hi otzaro".
In, legabbe moshe milleta zutarta hi. deamar rabbi chanina: mashal leadam shemvakkeshim mimmennu keli gadol, veyesh lo — dome alav kichli katan. katan, veen lo — dome alav kichli gadol.
"Modim modim" meshattekin oto.
Amar rabbi zera: kol haomer "shema shema" — keomer "modim modim" dame.
Metivi: hakkore et shema vechoflah — hare ze megunne. megunne hu dehave, shattoke la meshattekinan leh!
La kashya: ha, deamar milleta milleta vetane la. veha, deamar pesuka pesuka vetane leh.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: vedilma meikkara la kavvevn dateh, ulevassof kavvevn dateh?
Amar leh:

a: Chavruta kelappe shemayya mi ikka?! i la kavvevn dateh meikkara — machenan leh bemarzafta denappacha ad dimchavven dateh.
Mishna (haomer: "yevarchucha tovim" — hare ze darche minut). haover lifne hatteva vetaa — yaavor acher tachtav, velo yehe sarvan beotah shaa. mehechan hu matchil? mittechillat habberacha shettaa ze.
Haover lifne hatteva lo yaane "amen" achar hakkohanim, mippene hatteruf. veim en sham kohen ella hu — lo yissa et kappav. veim havetachato shehu nose et kappav, vechozer litfillato — rashshay.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: haover lifne hatteva — tzarich lesarev. veim eno mesarev — dome letavshil sheen bo melach. veim mesarev yoter midday — dome letavshil shehikdichattu melach. ketzad hu ose: paam rishona — yesarev, sheniyya — mehavehev, shelishit — poshet et raglav veyored.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha rubban — kashe, umiutan — yafe, veellu hen: seor, umelach, vesarvanut.
Amar rav huna: taa beshalosh rishonot — chozer larosh. beemtzaiyyot — chozer leatta chonen". beacharonot — chozer laavoda".
Verav assi amar: emtzaiyyot en lahen seder.
Metiv rav sheshet: mehechan hu chozer — mittechillat habberacha shettaa ze. teyuveta derav huna.
Amar lecha rav huna: emtzaiyyot kullehu chada bircheta ninhu.

Amar rav yehuda: leolam al yishal adam tzerachav lo beshalosh rishonot, velo beshalosh acharonot, ella beemtzaiyyot. deamar rabbi chanina: rishonot — dome leeved shemmesadder shevach lifne rabbo. emtzaiyyot — dome leeved shemvakkesh peras merabbo. acharonot — dome leeved shekkibbel peras merabbo, veniftar veholech lo.

Tanu rabbanan: maase betalmid echad sheyyarad lifne hatteva bifne rabbi eliezer, vehaya maarich yoter midday. amru lo talmidav: kamma archan hu ze! amar lahem: kelum maarich yoter mimmoshe rabbenu, dichtiv beh: "et arbaim hayyom veet arbaim hallayla vegomer"?!

Shuv maase betalmid echad sheyyarad lifne hatteva bifne rabbi eliezer, vehaya mekatztzer yoter midday. amru lo talmidav: kamma katzran hu ze! amar lahem: kelum mekatztzer yoter mimmoshe rabbenu, dichtiv: "el na refa na lah".
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rav chisda: kol hamevakkesh rachamim al chavero — en tzarich lehazekir shemo, shenneemar: "el na refa na lah", vela kamadkar shema demiryam.

Tanu rabbanan: ellu berachot sheadam shoche bahen: beavot", techilla vasof. bahodaa", techilla vasof. veim ba lashuach besof kol beracha uveracha, uvitchillat kol beracha uveracha — melammedin oto shello yishche.
Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: hedyot, kemo sheamarnu.
b: Kohen gadol, besof kol beracha uveracha. vehammelech, techillat kol beracha uveracha vesof kol beracha uveracha.

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: hedyot, kemo sheamarnu. kohen gadol, techillat kol beracha uveracha. hammelech — kevan shekkara shuv eno zokef, shenneemar: "vayhi kechallot shelomo lehitpallel vegomer kam millifne mizbach Adonai mikkeroa al birkav".

Tanu rabbanan: kidda — al appayim, shenneemar: "vattikkod bat sheva appayim eretz". keria — al birkayim, shenneemar "mikkeroa al birkav". hishtachavaa — zo pishshut yadayim veraglayim, shenneemar: "havo navo ani veimmecha veachecha lehishtachavot lecha artza".
Amar rav chiyyay bereh derav huna: chazena lehu leabbaye verava dematzlu atzloye.
Tane chada: hakkorea bahodaa — hare ze meshubbach. vetanya iddach: hare ze megunne!
La kashya: ha battechilla, ha levassof.
Rava kara behodaa techilla vasof. amri leh rabbanan: ammay ka aved mar hachi? amar lehu: chazena lerav nachman dechara vachazena leh lerav sheshet deka aved hachi.
Vehatanya hakkorea bahodaa — hare ze megunne!
Hahi behodaa shebbehallel".
Vehatanya: hakkorea bahodaa uvahodaa shel "hallel" — hare ze megunne.
Ki tanya hahi behodaa devirkat hammazon.

Mishna hammitpallel vetaa — siman ra lo. veim sheliach tzibbur hu — siman ra lesholchav, mippene sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto. amru alav al rabbi chanina ben dosa shehaya mitpallel al hacholim, veomer: "ze chay, veze met". amru lo: minnayin atta yodea? amar lahem: im shegura tefillati befi — yodea ani shehu mekubbal. veim lav — yodea ani shehu metoraf.
Gemara aheyay?
Amar rav chiyyay amar rav safra mishshum chad deve rabbi: beavot".
Ikka dematne la abbarayyta: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyechavven et libbo bechullan, veim eno yachol lechavven bechullan — yechavven et libbo beachat.
Amar rabbi chiyyay amar rav safra mishshum chad deve rabbi: beavot".
Amru alav al rabbi chanina vechulei: mena hane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: deamar kera: "bore niv sefatayim shalom shalom larachok velakkarov amar Adonai urefativ".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella lammassi bitto letalmid chacham, velaose perakmatya letalmid chacham, velamhanne talmid chacham minnechasav. aval talmide chachamim atzman — "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo".
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella limot hammashiach, aval leolam habba, "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha".
Ufeliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchuyot bilvad. shenneemar: "ki lo yechdal evyon mikkerev haaretz".
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella levaale teshuva, aval tzaddikim gemurim "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha".
Ufeliga derabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu: makom shebbaale teshuva omdin — tzaddikim gemurim enam omdin, shenneemar: "shalom shalom larachok velakkarov". "larachok" beresha, vahadar "lakkarov".
Verabbi yochanan amar lecha: may "rachok" — shehaya rachok middevar avera meikkara. umay "karov" — shehaya karov lidvar avera, venitrachek mimmennu hasheta.
May "ayin lo raata"? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ze yayin hameshummar baanavav mishsheshet yeme bereshit. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze eden, shello shalta bo en kol beriyya.
Shemma tomar: adam harishon hechan haya? baggan.
Veshemma tomar: hu gan, hu eden, talmud lomar: "venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan", gan lechud veeden lechud.

Tanu rabbanan: maase shechala beno shel rabban gamliel. shigger shene talmide chachamim etzel rabbi chanina ben dosa levakkesh alav rachamim. kevan sheraa otam, ala laaliyyay, uvikkesh alav rachamim. biridato amar lahem: lechu, shechalatzattu chamma. amru lo: vechi navi atta?! amar lahen: lo navi anochi velo ven navi anochi, ella kach mekkubbelani: im shegura tefillati befi — yodea ani shehu mekubbal, veim lav — yodea ani shehu metoraf. yashvu vechatvu vechivvevnu otah shaa. ucheshebbau etzel rabban gamliel, amar lahen: haavoda, lo chissartem velo hotartem, ella kach haya maase beotah shaa chalatzattu chamma veshaal lanu mayim lishtot.

Veshuv maase berabbi chanina ben dosa shehalach lilmod tora etzel rabbi yochanan ben zakkay, vechala beno shel rabbi yochanan ben zakkay. amar lo: chanina beni, bakkesh alav rachamim veyichye. hinniach rosho ben birkav uvikkesh alav rachamim, vechaya. amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: ilmale hetiach ben zakkay et rosho ben birkav kol hayyom kullo — lo hayu mashgichim alav. amra lo ishto: vechi chanina gadol mimmecha? amar lah: lav, ella hu dome keeved lifne hammelech, vaani dome kesar lifne hammelech.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: al yitpallel adam ella bevayit sheyyesh sham challonot. shenneemar: "vechavvin petichan leh beillite (lokovel) [neged] yerushelem".
Amar rav kahana: chatzif alay man dimtzalle bevakta.
Veamar rav kahana: chatzif alay man dimfaresh chiteh, shenneemar: "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa".
Haderan alach en omdin

a: Mishna ketzad mevarchin al happerot? al perot hailan hu omer: "bore peri haetz", chutz min hayyayin, sheal hayyayin hu omer: "bore peri haggefen". veal perot haaretz hu omer: "bore peri haadama", chutz min happat, sheal happat hu omer: "hammotzi lechem min haaretz". veal hayyerakot hu omer: "bore peri haadama". rabbi yehuda omer: "bore mine deshaim".
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "kodesh hillulim laAdonai", melammed shetteunim beracha lifnehem uleacharehem. mikkan amar rabbi akiva: asur leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyyevarech.

Vehay "kodesh hillulim" lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh chad deamar rachamana achaleh vahadar ichleh. veidach davar hattaun shira, taun chillul, vesheeno taun shira, en taun chillul. vechidrabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin? — shenneemar: "vattomer lahem haggefen hechodalti et tiroshi hamesammeach elohim vaanashim", im anashim mesammeach, elohim bamme mesammeach? mikkan sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin!
Hanicha leman detane "neta revai". ella leman detane "kerem revai" may ikka lememar? deittemar rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi, chad tane "kerem revai", vechad tane "neta revai".

Uleman detane "kerem revai" hanicha i yalef gezera shava. detanya, rabbi omer: neemar kan "lehosif lachem tevuato", veneemar lehallan "utevuat hakkarem". ma lehallan kerem, af kan kerem. iyyattar leh chad "hillul" livracha.
Vei la yalef gezera shava, beracha mena leh? vei name yalef gezera shava, ashkechan leacharav, lefanav minnayin?
Ha la kashya, deatya bekal vachomer: keshehu savea mevarech, keshehu raev — lo kol shekken.
Ashkechan kerem, shear minin minnayin?
Deyalef mikkerem: ma kerem davar shennehene vetaun beracha, af kol davar shennehene — taun beracha.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lecherem shekken chayyayv beolelot!
Kama tochiach. ma lekama shekken chayyevet bechalla!
Kerem yochiach. vechazar haddin: lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen: davar shennehene vetaun beracha, af kol davar shennehene — taun beracha.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bo tzad mizbeach. veate name zayit deit beh tzad mizbeach.
Vezayit mitztzad mizbeach ate? veha behedya ketiv beh "kerem", dichtiv "vayyaver miggadish vead kama vead kerem zayit". amar rav pappa: "kerem zayit" ikkere, "kerem" setama la ikkere.

Mikkol makom kashya: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach! ella, deyalef la mishshivat hamminin: ma shivat hamminin davar shennehene vetaun beracha, af kol davar shennehene taun beracha.
Ma leshivat hamminin shekken chayyayvin bevikkurim? veod: hatinach leacharav, lefanav minnayin?
Ha la kashya deate bekal vachomer: keshehu savea mevarech, keshehu raev — lo kol shekken.
Uleman detane "neta revai", ha tinach kol devar netia. delav bar netia, kegon basar betzim vedagim mena leh? ella sevara hu: asur lo laadam sheyyehane min haolam hazze belo beracha.
Tanu rabbanan: asur lo laadam sheyyehane min haolam hazze belo beracha. vechol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha maal. may takkanteh? — yelech etzel chacham.
Yelech etzel chacham?! may aved leh? ha avad leh issura! ella amar rava: yelech etzel chacham meikkara vilammedennu berachot kede shello yavo lide meila.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha keillu nehena mikkodshe shamayim, shenneemar: "laAdonai haaretz umeloah". rabbi levi rame: ketiv "laAdonai haaretz umeloah", uchetiv "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam"! la kashya kan kodem beracha,
b: Kan leachar beracha.

Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha keillu gozel lehakkadosh baruch hu ucheneset yisrael, shenneemar: "gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit". veen "aviv" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "halo hu avich kanecha", veen "immo" ella keneset yisrael, shenneemar: "shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha".
May "chaver hu leish mashchit"? amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: chaver hu leyarovam ben nevat shehishchit et yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim.
Rabbi chanina bar pappa rame: ketiv "velakachti degani beitto vegomer", uchetiv "veasafta deganecha vegomer".
La kashya: kan bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom, kan bizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom.

Tanu rabbanan: "veasafta deganecha" ma talmud lomar? — lefi shenneemar: "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha" — yachol devarim kichtavan, talmud lomar: "veasafta deganecha" — haneheg bahen minhag derech eretz, divre rabbi yishmael.

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: efshar adam choresh bishat charisha, vezorea bishat zeria, vekotzer bishat ketzira, vedash bishat disha, vezore bishat haruach, tora ma tehe aleha? ella bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom — melachtan naaset al yede acherim, shenneemar: "veamdu zarim verau tzonchem vegomer", uvizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom — melachtan naaset al yede atzman, shenneemar: "veasafta deganecha". velo od ella shemmelechet acherim naaset al yadan, shenneemar: "veavadta et oyvecha vegomer".
Amar abbaye: harebe asu kerabbi yishmael, vealta beyadan. kerabbi shimon ben yochay, velo alta beyadan.
Amar lehu rava lerabbanan: bematuta minnayychu, beyome nisan uveyome tishre la titchazo kammay, ki hechi dela tittardu bimzonayychu kulla shatta.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: bo uree shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim. dorot harishonim asu toratan keva umelachtan aray, zo vazo nitkayyeyma beyadan. dorot haacharonim sheasu melachtan keva vetoratan aray, zo vazo lo nitkayyeyma beyadan.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: bo uree shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim. dorot harishonim hayu machnisin perotehen derech teraksemon kede lechayyeyvan bemaaser, dorot haacharonim machnisin perotehen derech gaggot, derech chatzerot, derech karpefot, kede lefotran min hammaaser. deamar rabbi yannay: en hattevel mitchayyev bemaaser ad sheyyire pene habbayit, shenneemar: "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit".
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chatzer kovaat, shenneemar: "veachlu visharecha vesaveu".

Chutz min hayyayin vechulei: may shena yayin? illema mishshum deishtanni leilluya ishtanni livracha, vahare shemen, deishtanni leilluya vela ishtanni livracha, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel, vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: shemen zayit mevarchin alav "bore peri haetz".
Amri: hatam mishshum dela efshar. hechi nevarech? nevarech "bore peri hazzayit" — pera gufeh "zayit" ikkeri.
Unevarech aleh "bore peri etz zayit"? ella amar mar zutera: chamra — zayen, mishcha — la zayen.
Umishcha la zayen? vehatnan hannoder min hammazon — muttar bammayim uvammelach. vehavenan ba: mayim umelach hu dela ikkeri "mazon", ha kol mille ikkeri "mazon".
Nema tehve teyuveta derav ushemuel, deamri en mevarchin "bore mine mezonot" ella bachameshet hamminin bilvad. veamar rav huna: beomer "kol hazzan alay".

Alma mishcha zayen! ella, chamra saed, umishcha la saed. vechamra mi saed? veha rava hava shate chamra kol maale yoma defischa ki hechi denigrereh lelibbeh venechol matztza tefe? tuva — garer, pureta — saed.

Umi saed kelal?! vehachtiv: "veyayin yesammach levav enosh velechem levav enosh yisad vegomer" — nahama hu desaed chamra la saed! ella, chamra it beh tarte: saed umesammach. nahama misad saed, sammoche la mesammach.
I hachi nevarech aleh shalosh berachot! la kavi inashe seodtayyhu illaveh.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: i kava illaveh seodteh may? amar leh: lichsheyyavo eliyyahu veyomar i have keviuta. hasheta miha batla dato etzel kol adam.

Gufa. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: shemen zayit mevarchin alav "bore peri haetz". hechi dame? illema deka shate leh mishta — ozoke mazzik leh. detanya: hashshote shemen shel teruma — meshallem et hakkeren, veeno meshallem et hachomesh. hassach shemen shel teruma — meshallem et hakkeren umeshallem et hachomesh.

Ella deka achel leh al yede pat. i hachi, havya leh pat ikkar vehu tafel. utenan, ze hakkelal: kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela — mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela! ella deka shate leh al yede "anigron", deamar rabba bar shemuel: "anigron" — mayya desilka, "ansigron" — mayya

a: Dechullehu shilke.
Im ken, have leh anigron ikkar veshemen tafel, utenan, ze hakkelal: kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela, mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela!
Hacha bemay askinan — bechoshesh bigrono. detanya: hachoshesh bigrono lo yearennu beshemen techilla beshabbat, aval noten shemen harebe letoch anigron uvolea.
Peshita! mahu detema: kevan delirfua ka mechavven la levarech aleh kelal, ka mashma lan kevan deit leh hanaa minneh, bae baroche.
Kimcha dechitte, rav yehuda amar: "bore peri haadama", verav nachman amar: "shehakkol nihye bidvaro".

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: la tiflog aleh derav yehuda, derabbi yochanan ushemuel kayymi kevoteh. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel, vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: shemen zayit mevarchin alav "bore peri haetz". alma: af al gav deishtanni — bemilleteh kae. ha name, af al gav deishtanni — bemilleteh kae.
Mi dame? hatam — let leh illuya acharina, hacha — it leh illuya acharina befat.

Vechi it leh illuya acharina la mevarchinan aleh "bore peri haadama" ella "shehakkol"? veha amar rabbi zera amar rav matna amar shemuel: akkara chayyay vekimcha disare mevarchinan alayyhu "shehakkol nihya bidvaro". may lav dechitte bore peri haadama!
La, dechitte name "shehakkol nihya bidvaro".
Velashmeinan dechitte vechol shekken disare!
I ashmeinan dechitte hava amena hane mille dechitte, aval disare la levarech aleh kelal, ka mashma lan.

Umi gara mimmelach vezamit, ditnan al hammelach veal hazzamit omer "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". itzterich, salka datach amena melach vezamit aved inash deshade lefummeh, aval kimcha disare hoil vekashe lekukeyane, la levarech aleh kelal, ka mashma lan kevan deit leh hanaa minneh bae baroche.
Kora, rav yehuda amar: "bore peri haadama", ushemuel amar: "shehakkol nihye bidvaro".
Rav yehuda amar "bore peri haadama", pera hu. ushemuel amar "shehakkol nihya bidvaro", hoil vesofo lehakeshot.

Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, kevotach mistabbera, deha tzenon sofo lehakeshot umevarchinan aleh "bore peri haadama". vela hi: tzenon nati inashe addata defugela, dikla la nati inashe addata dekora.

Vechol hecha dela nati inashe addata dehachi la mevarchinan aleh? vahare tzalaf, denati inashe addata defircha, utenan: al mine nitzpa, al healin veal hattemarot omer "bore peri haadama", veal haaviyyonot veal hakkafresin omer "bore peri haetz".
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tzalaf nati inashe addata deshuta, dikla la nati inashe addata dekora. veaf al gav dekalleseh shemuel lerav yehuda, hilcheta kevoteh dishmuel.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: tzalaf shel orla bechutza laaretz zorek et haaviyyonot veochel et hakkafresin. lememra daaviyyonot pere vekafresin lav pere? ureminhu: al mine nitzpa, al healim veal hattemarot omer "bore peri haadama", veal haaviyyonot veal hakkafresin omer "bore peri haetz"!
Hu deamar kerabbi akiva. ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: tzalaf mitasser temarot vaaviyyonot vekafresin. rabbi akiva omer: en mitasser ella aviyyonot bilvad, mippene shehu peri.
Venema: "halacha kerabbi akiva"! i amar halacha kerabbi akiva, hava amena afillu baaretz, ka mashma lan: kol hammekel baaretz — halacha kemoto bechutza laaretz, aval baaretz — la.

Venema: "halacha kerabbi akiva bechutza laaretz", dechol hammekel baaretz — halacha kemoto bechutza laaretz. i amar hachi, hava amena hane mille gabbe masar ilan, devaaretz gufa midderabbanan, aval gabbe orla, devaaretz middeorayyta, ema bechutza laaretz name nigzor, ka mashma lan.

Ravina ashkecheh lemar bar rav ashe deka zarek aviyyonot vekaachel kafresin. amar leh: may datach, kerabbi akiva demekel? veleeved mar kevet shammay dimkilli tefe! ditnan: tzalaf, bet shammay omrim: kilayim bakkerem. uvet hallel omrim: en kilayim bakkerem. ellu veellu modim shechayyayv beorla.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat tzalaf bet shammay omrim kilayim bakkerem, alma min yarak hu, vahadar tane: ellu veellu modim shechayyayv beorla, alma min ilan hu!

Ha la kashya: bet shammay sappoke mesappeka lehu, veavdi hacha lechumera vehacha lechumera. mikkol makom, levet shammay have leh safek orla, utenan: safek orla — beeretz yisrael asur, uvesureya muttar. uvechutza laaretz yored
b: Velokeach — uvilvad shello yirennu loket.
Rabbi akiva bimkom rabbi eliezer avdinan kevateh, uvet shammay bimkom bet hillel — enah mishna.
Vetippok leh denaasa shomer lapperi, verachamana amar: "vaaraltem orlato et piryo", et hattafel lefiryo, umay nihu — shomer lapperi.
Amar rava: hecha amrinan denaasa shomer lapperi — hecha deiteh ben betalush ben bimchubbar, hacha bimchubbar — iteh, betalush — leteh.

Etiveh abbaye: pitma shel rimmon mitztarefet, vehannetz shello en mitztaref. middekaamar hannetz shello en mitztaref, alma delav ochel hu. utenan gabbe orla: kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello, kelippe egozim vehaggarinin chayyayvin beorla.
Ella amar rava: hecha amrinan denaasa lehu shomer lefere — hecha deiteh bishat gemar pera, hay kafres leteh bishat gemar pera.
Ini?! vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hane metachale deorla asiri, hoil venaasu shomer lefere. veshomer lefere immat have — bechufera, veka kare leh "shomer lefere".
Rav nachman savar la kerabbi yose, ditnan rabbi yose omer: semadar asur mippene shehu peri. ufeligi rabbanan aleh.

Matkif la rav shimi minnehardea: uvishar ilane mi peligi rabbanan aleh? vehatnan: meematay en kotztzin et hailanot bashsheviit — bet shammay omrim: kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu, uvet hillel omrim: hecharuvin mishsheyyesharsheru, vehaggefanim mishsheyyegaru, vehazzetim mishsheyyanetzu, ushear kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu.

Veamar rav assi: hu boser, hu gerua, hu pol hallavan. pol hallavan salka datach?! ella ema: shiuro kefol hallavan. man shamat leh deamar boser in, semadar la — rabbanan, vekatane shear kol hailanot — mishsheyyotziu?
Ella amar rava: hecha amrinan dehave shomer lefere — hecha dechi shaklat leh leshomer mayet pera. hacha ki shaklat leh — la mayet pera.
Hava ovada veshaklu lenetz derimmona, vivash rimmona, veshaklu lefircha devitita — veikkayyaym bitita.

(Vehilcheta kemar bar rav ashe dezarek et haaviyyonot veachel et hakkafresin. umiddilgabbe orla lav pera ninhu, legabbe berachot name lav pera ninhu, vela mevarchinan aleh "bore peri haetz", ella "bore peri haadama".)
Pilpele, rav sheshet amar: "shehakkol", rava amar: la chelum. veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: kas pilpele beyoma dechippure — patur, kas zangevila beyoma dechippure — patur.

Metivi, haya rabbi meir omer: mimmashma shenneemar "vaaraltem orlato et piryo" eni yodea sheetz maachol hu? ella ma talmud lomar "etz maachol" — lehavi etz shettaam etzo ufiryo shave, veezehu? — ze happilpelin. lelammedcha shehappilpelin chayyayvin beorla, ulelammedcha sheen eretz yisrael chasera kelum, shenneemar: "eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem lo techsar kol bah".
La kashya: ha berattivta, ha beyabbishta.

Amri leh rabbanan lemarimar: kas zangevila beyoma dechippure patur? veha amar rava: hay himleta deatya mibbe hindue — sharya, umevarchinan ala "bore peri haadama". la kashya: ha berattivta, ha beyabbishta.

Chavitz kedera vechen dayysa, rav yehuda amar: "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". rav kahana amar: "bore mine mezonot". bedayysa gereda kulle alma la peligi devore mine mezonot". ki peligi bedayysa keen chavitz kedera, rav yehuda amar "shehakkol", savar duvesha ikkar. rav kahana amar "bore mine mezonot", savar semida ikkar. amar rav yosef: kevateh derav kahana mistabbera, derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kol sheyyesh bo mechameshet hamminin mevarchin alav "bore mine mezonot".

Gufa: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu kol sheyyesh bo mechameshet hamminin mevarchin alav "bore mine mezonot". veittemar name, rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kol shehu mechameshet hamminin mevarchin alav bore mine mezonot.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan "kol shehu" hava amena mishshum deiteh beeneh, aval al yede taarovot — la.

a: Ka mashma lan — "kol sheyyesh bo". vei ashmeinan "kol sheyyesh bo" have amena kol sheyyesh bo chameshet hamminim — in, aval orez vedochan — la, mishshum deal yede taarovet. aval iteh beeneh — nema afillu orez vedochan name mevarchin alav "bore mine mezonot". ka mashma lan — kol shehu mechameshet hamminim hu dimvarchin alav bore mine mezonot, leappoke orez vedochan, daafillu iteh beeneh la mevarchinan "bore mine mezonot".

Veorez vedochan la mevarchinan "bore mine mezonot"? vehatanya: heviu lefanav pat orez ufat dochan — mevarech alav techilla vasof kemaase kedera. vegabbe maase kedera tanya: battechilla mevarech alav "bore mine mezonot", ulevassof mevarech alav beracha achat meen shalosh.

Kemaase kedera vela kemaase kedera: kemaase kedera dimvarchin alav techilla vasof, vela kemaase kedera deillu bemaase kedera — battechilla "bore mine mezonot" ulevassof beracha meen shalosh, veillu hacha — battechilla mevarech alav "shehakkol nihye bidvaro", ulevassof "bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan al kol ma shebbarata".
Veorez lav maase kedera hu? vehatanya, ellu hen maase kedera: chilka, targis, solet, zariz, vearsan, veorez.
Ha manni — rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi. detanya: rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: orez min dagan hu, vechayyayvin al chimmutzo karet, veadam yotze bo yede chovato bappesach. aval rabbanan la.

Verabbanan la?! vehatanya: hakkoses et hachitta mevarech aleha "bore peri haadama". techanah afaah uvishshelah, bizman shehapperusot kayyaymot — battechilla mevarech aleha "hammotzi lechem min haaretz", ulevassof mevarech aleha shalosh berachot. im en happerusot kayyaymot — battechilla mevarech aleha "bore mine mezonot", ulevassof mevarech aleha beracha achat meen shalosh.

Hakkoses et haorez mevarech alav "bore peri haadama". techano afao uvishshelo, af al pi shehapperusot kayyaymot, battechilla mevarech alav "bore mine mezonot", ulevassof mevarech alav beracha achat meen shalosh.
Manni, illema rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi deamar orez min dagan hu, "hammotzi lechem min haaretz" veshalosh berachot bae baroche!
Ella lav, rabbanan hi, uteyuveta derav ushemuel!
Teyuveta.

Amar mar: hakkoses et hachitta mevarech aleha "bore peri haadama". vehatanya "bore mine zeraim"! la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, veha rabbanan. ditnan: veal yerakot omer "bore peri haadama", rabbi yehuda omer: "bore mine deshaim".

Amar mar, hakkoses et haorez mevarech alav "bore peri haadama". techano afao uvishshelo, af al pi shehapperusot kayyaymot, battechilla mevarech alav "bore mine mezonot", ulevassof beracha achat meen shalosh.

Vehatanya levassof vela chelum! amar rav sheshet: la kashya: ha rabban gamliel, veha rabbanan. detanya, ze hakkelal: kol shehu mishshivat hamminim, rabban gamliel omer shalosh berachot, vachachamim omrim beracha achat meen shalosh.

Umaase berabban gamliel vehazzekenim shehayu mesubbin baaliyyay biricho, veheviu lifnehem kotavot veachlu, venatan rabban gamliel reshut lerabbi akiva levarech. kafatz uverach rabbi akiva beracha achat meen shalosh. amar leh rabban gamliel: akiva, ad matay atta machnis roshcha ben hammachaloket! amar lo: rabbenu, af al pi sheatta omer ken vachaverecha omrim ken, limmadtanu rabbenu yachid verabbim halacha karabbim.
Rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo: kol shehu mishshivat hamminim
b: Velo min dagan hu, o min dagan velo asao pat — rabban gamliel omer shalosh berachot, vachachamim omrim beracha achat. kol sheeno lo mishshivat hamminin velo min dagan, kegon pat orez vedochan — rabban gamliel omer beracha achat meen shalosh, vachachamim omrim velo chelum.

Bemay okimta — kerabban gamliel? ema sefa deresha, im en happerusot kayyaymot — battechilla mevarech aleha "bore mine mezonot", ulevassof mevarech aleha beracha achat meen shalosh. manni: i rabban gamliel, hasheta akkotavot veaddayysa amar rabban gamliel shalosh berachot, im en happerusot kayyaymot mibbaya?!
Ella peshita rabbanan. i hachi kashya derabbanan adderabbanan! ella leolam rabbanan, uteni gabbe orez: "ulevassof eno mevarech alav velo kelum".

Amar rava: hay rihata dechaklae demappeshi beh kimcha, mevarech "bore mine mezonot". may tama? — dismida ikkar. demachoza, dela mappeshi beh kimcha, mevarech alav "shehakkol nihya bidvaro". may tama? — duvesha ikkar. vahadar amar rava: idde veidde, "bore mine mezonot". derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kol sheyyesh bo mechameshet hamminim mevarchin alav "bore mine mezonot".

Amar rav yosef: hay chavitza deit beh perurin kezayit — battechilla mevarech alav "hammotzi lechem min haaretz", ulevassof mevarech alav shalosh berachot. delet beh perurin kezayit — battechilla mevarech alav "bore mine mezonot", ulevassof beracha achat meen shalosh.

Amar rav yosef: mena amena la — detanya: haya omed umakriv menachot birushalayim — omer: "baruch shehecheyaynu vekiyyamnu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze". netalan leochlan — mevarech "hammotzi lechem min haaretz". vetane ala: vechullan, pottan kezayit.

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, letanna deve rabbi yishmael deamar porchan ad shemmachziran lesoltan, hachi name dela bae baroche "hammotzi lechem min haaretz"?! vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: lakat mikkullan kezayit vaachalan, im chametz hu — anush karet, veim matztza hu — adam yotze bo yede chovato bappesach.
Hacha bemay askinan — besheersan. i hachi ema sefa, vehu sheachalan bichde achilat peras — vei besheersan, hay "sheachalan", "sheachalo" mibbee leh?
Ella hacha bemay askinan — beva millechem gadol.
May have ala? amar rav sheshet: hay chavitza, af al gav delet beh perurin kezayit — mevarech alav "hammotzi lechem min haaretz". amar rava: vehu deikka aleh torita denahma.
Teroknin, chayyayvin bachalla. vechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: teroknin peturin min hachalla. may teroknin? amar abbaye: kubba deara.
Veamar abbaye: terita petura min hachalla. may terita? ikka deamri gevil merattach, veikka deamri nahama dehindeka, veikka deamri lechem heasuy lechuttach.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: lechem heasuy lechuttach patur min hachalla. veha tanya chayyayv bachalla! hatam kidkatane tama — rabbi yehuda omer: maaseha mochichin aleha. asaan

a: Keavin — chayyayvin, kelimmudin — peturim. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: hay kubba deara may mevarchin illaveh? amar leh: mi savrat nahama hu?! guvela bealma hu umevarchin illaveh "bore mine mezonot".
Mar zutera keva seodteh illaveh, uvarech illaveh "hammotzi lechem min haaretz", veshalosh berachot.
Amar mar bar rav ashe: veadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach, may tama — "lechem oni" karenan beh.
Veamar mar bar rav ashe: hay duvesha detamre mevarchin illaveh "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". may tama? — zea bealma hu.
Keman? — ki hay tanna ditnan devash temarim, veyen tappuchim, vechometz sifvaniyyot, ushear me ferot shel teruma — rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vachomesh, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: terima mahu? la hava addateh derava may kaamar leh. yetev ravina kammeh derava, amar leh: deshumeshme ka amrat, o dekuretme ka amrat, o defuretzane ka amrat?

Addehachi vehachi assekeh rava ledateh, amar leh: chashilta vadday ka amrat, veadkartan milleta ha deamar rav assi: hay tamre shel teruma muttar laasot mehen terima, veasur laasot mehen shechar. vehilcheta tamre veavdinhu terima — mevarchin illavayyhu "bore peri haetz". may tama? — bemilletayyhu kayymi kidmeikkara.
Shetita, rav amar "shehakkol nihye bidvaro", ushemuel amar "bore mine mezonot".
Amar rav chisda, vela peligi: ha beava, ha berakka. ava laachila avdi la, rakka lirfua ka avdi la.
Metiv rav yosef: veshavin shebbochashin et hashshattut beshabbat veshotin zetom hammitzri. vei salka datach lirfua ka mechavven, refua beshabbat mi shere?!

Amar leh abbaye: veat la tisbera? veha tenan: kol haochalin ochel adam lirfua beshabbat, vechol hammashkin shote. ella ma it lach lememar — gavra laachila ka mechavven, hachi name gavra laachila ka mechavven.
Lishshana acharina: ella ma it lach lememar — gavra laachila ka mechavven, urefua mimmela ka havya? hachi name laachila ka mechavven, urefua mimmela ka havya.

Utzericha derav ushemuel. dei mehay, hava amena laachila ka mechavven urefua mimmela ka havya, aval hacha, kevan dilchattechilla lirfua ka mechavven — la levarech illaveh kelal. ka mashma lan kevan deit leh hanaa minneh bae baroche.

Sheal happat hu omer "hammotzi" vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ma hu omer? — "hammotzi lechem min haaretz". rabbi nechemya omer: "motzi lechem min haaretz". amar rava: bemotzi" kulle alma la peligi deappek mashma, dichtiv: "el motziam mimmitzrayim". ki peligi behammotzi", rabbanan savri hammotzi deappek mashma, dichtiv: "hammotzi lecha mayim mitztzur hachallamish". verabbi nechemya savar hammotzi demappek mashma, shenneemar: "hammotzi etchem mittachat sivlot mitzrayim".

Verabbanan? — hahu hachi kaamar lehu kudesha berich hu leyisrael: kad mappekna lechu, avedna lechu milleta ki hechi deyaditu daana hu deappekit yatchon mimmitzrayim, dichtiv: "vidatem ki ani Adonai elohechem hammotzi".

Mishtabbechin leh rabbanan lerabbi zera [et] bar rav zevid achu derabbi shemuel bar rav zevid deadam gadol hu uvaki bivrachot hu. amar lahem: lichsheyyavo leyedchem haviuhu leyadi. zimna chada ikkela legabbeh appiku leh rifta, patach veamar "motzi". amar: ze hu sheomrim alav deadam gadol hu uvaki bivrachot hu?! bishlama i amar "hammotzi"
b: Ashmeinan tama, veashmeinan dehilcheta kerabbanan. ella daamar "motzi" may ka mashma lan? veihu daavad leappoke nafsheh mippelugeta.
Vehilcheta "hammotzi lechem min haaretz", dekayyma lan kerabbanan, deamri deappek mashma.

Veal hayyerakot omer vechulei. katane yerakot dumeya defat — ma pat shennishtanna al yede haur, af yerakot name shennishtannu al yede haur. amar ravnay mishshemeh deabbaye: zot omeret shelakot mevarchin alehen "bore peri haadama". mimmay? — middekatane yerakot dumeya defat.

Darash rav chisda mishshum rabbenu, umannu — rav: shelakot mevarchin alehem "bore peri haadama". verabbotenu hayyordin meeretz yisrael, umannu — ulla mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amar: shelakot mevarchin alehen "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". vaani omer: kol shettechillato "bore peri haadama", shelako — "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". vechol shettechillato "shehakkol nihye bidvaro", shelako — "bore peri haadama".

Bishlama kol shettechillato "shehakkol nihye bidvaro" shelako "bore peri haadama" — mashkachat la bichrava vesilka vekara, ella kol shettechillato "bore peri haadama" shelako "shehakkol", hechi mashkachat la? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mashkachat la betume vecharate.

Darash rav nachman mishshum rabbenu, umannu — shemuel: shelakot mevarchin alehem "bore peri haadama". vachaverenu hayyordim meeretz yisrael, umannu — ulla mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amar: shelakot mevarchin alehen "shehakkol nihye bidvaro".

Vaani omer bemachaloket shenuya. detanya: yotzin berakik hashsharuy uvimvushshal shello nimmoach divre rabbi meir, verabbi yose omer: yotzim berakik hashsharuy, aval lo bamvushshal, af al pi shello nimmoach.
Vela hi, dechulle alma shelakot mevarchin alehen "bore peri haadama", vead kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam, ella mishshum devaenan taam matztza, velekka, aval hacha afillu rabbi yose mode.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: shelakot mevarchin alehem "bore peri haadama", verabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi yochanan: shelakot mevarchin alehem "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: keva ulla leshabbeshteh kerabbi binyamin bar yefet.

Tahe ba rabbi zera: vechi ma inyan rabbi binyamin bar yefet etzel rabbi chiyyay bar abba? rabbi chiyyay bar abba dayek vegamar shemata merabbi yochanan rabbeh, verabbi binyamin bar yefet la dayek. veod, rabbi chiyyay bar abba kol telatin yomin mahdar talmudeh kammeh derabbi yochanan rabbeh, verabbi binyamin bar yefet la mahdar. veod, bar min den uvar min den, dehahu turemsa deshalki leh sheva zimnin bikdera veachli leh bekinnuach seuda, ato usheilu lerabbi yochanan, veamar lehu: mevarchin illaveh "bore peri haadama".

Veod, amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ani raiti et rabbi yochanan sheachal zayit maliach, uverach alav techilla vasof. i amrat bishlama shelakot bemilletayyhu kayymi — battechilla mevarech alav "bore peri haetz", ulevassof mevarech alav beracha achat meen shalosh. ella i amrat shelakot lav bemilletayyhu kayymi, bishlama battechilla mevarech alav "shehakkol nihye bidvaro" — ella levassof may mevarech?
Dilma "bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan al kol ma shebbara".

Metiv rav yitzchak bar shemuel: yerakot sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach — yotze bahen uvakkelach shellahen, aval lo kevushin, velo shelukin, velo mevushshalin. vei salka datach bemilletayyhu kae — shelukin ammay la?
Shane hatam, devaenan taam maror, velekka.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: rabbi yochanan hechi mevarech al zayit maliach? kevan dishkila legarineh

a: Batzar leh shiura.
Amar leh: mi savrat kezayit gadol baenan? kezayit benoni baenan (veha ikka), vehahu deayyto lekammeh derabbi yochanan zayit gadol hava, deaf al gav deshakluha legarinuteh pash leh shiura.

Ditnan: zayit sheamru lo katan velo gadol, ella benoni — vezehu "egori". veamar rabbi avahu: lo "egori" shemo ella "ivroti" shemo, veamri la "simrosi" shemo. velamma nikra shemo "egori" — sheshshamno agur betocho.

Nema ketannae: dehanhu tere talmide dahavo yatvi kammeh devar kappara. heviu lefanav keruv vedormaskin ufargiyyot. natan bar kappara reshut leechad mehen levarech, kafatz uverach al happargiyyot. ligleg alav chavero. kaas bar kappara amar: lo al hamevarech ani koes, ella al hamelagleg ani koes. im chavercha dome kemi shello taam taam basar meolam, atta al ma liglagta alav? chazar veamar: lo al hamelagleg ani koes, ella al hamevarech ani koes. veamar: im chachma en kan, zikna en kan?!
Tana: ushenehem lo hotziu shenatan.

May lav beha ka mippalgi, dimvarech savar shelakot ufargiyyot "shehakkol nihye bidvaro", hilkach chabbiv adif, umelagleg savar shelakot "bore peri haadama", pargiyyot "shehakkol nihye bidvaro", hilkach pera adif.
La, dechulle alma shelakot ufargiyyot "shehakkol nihya bidvaro", vehacha behay sevara ka mippalgi: mar savar chabbiv adif, umar savar keruv adif, dezayen.

Amar rabbi zera, ki havenan be rav huna amar lan: hane gargelide delifta, parminhu perima rabba — "bore peri haadama", perima zuta — "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". vechi atan leve rav yehuda amar lan: idde veidde "bore peri haadama", veha defarminhu tefe, ki hechi denimtik tameh.

Amar rav ashe, ki havenan be rav kahana amar lan: tavshila desilka, dela mappeshu ba kimcha — "bore peri haadama". delifta, demappeshu ba kimcha tefe — "bore mine mezonot". vahadar amar: idde veidde "bore peri haadama", vehay deshade ba kimcha tefe — ledabboke bealma avdi la.
Amar rav chisda: tavshil shel teradin yafe lallev, vetov laenayim, vechol shekken livne meayim. amar abbaye: vehu deyatev abbe tafe veaved "toch toch".

Amar rav pappa: peshita li mayya desilka — kesilka, umayya delifta — kelifta, umayya dechullehu shilke — kechullehu shilke. bae rav pappa: mayya deshivta may? lemattoke tama avdi, o leabbore zuhama avdi la?
Ta shema: hashshevet mishshennatna taam bakkedera en bah mishshum teruma, veenah metammea tumeat ochalim. shema minna lemattoke tama avdi la. shema minna.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe: pat tzenuma bikara mevarchin aleha "hammotzi". ufeliga derabbi chiyyay, deamar rabbi chiyyay: tzarich shettichle beracha im happat.
Matkif la rava: may shena tzenuma dela, mishshum dechi kalya beracha — apperusa ka kalya? al happat name, ki ka gamra — apperusa gamra!
b: Ella amar rava: mevarech veachar kach botzea.

Nehardae avdi kerabbi chiyyay verabbanan avdi kerava. amar ravina: amra li em, avuch aved kerabbi chiyyay, deamar rabbi chiyyay: tzarich shettichle beracha im happat. verabbanan avdi kerava. vehilcheta kerava, deamar mevarech veachar kach botzea.

Ittemar: heviu lifnehem petitin ushelemin, amar rav huna: mevarech al happetitin ufoter et hashshelemin. verabbi yochanan amar: shelema mitzva min hammuvechar. aval perusa shel chittin ushelema min hasseorin, divre hakkol mevarech al happerusa shel chittin, ufoter et hashshelema shel seorin.

Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba ketannae: tormin batzal katan shalem, aval lo chatzi batzal gadol. rabbi yehuda omer: lo chi, ella chatzi batzal gadol. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar chashuv adif, umar savar shalem adif.

Hecha deikka kohen, kulle alma la peligi dechashuv adif. ki peligi delekka kohen. ditnan: kol makom sheyyesh kohen — torem min hayyafe, vechol makom sheen kohen — torem min hammitkayyem. rabbi yehuda omer: en torem ella min hayyafe.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: vire shamayim yotze yede shenehen, umannu? — mar bereh deravina, demar bereh deravina manniach perusa betoch hashshelema uvotzea.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bar yitzchak: manniach happerusa betoch hashshelema uvotzea umevarech. amar leh: ma shimcha? amar leh: shalman. amar leh: shalom atta ushelema mishnatcha, shessamta shalom ben hattalmidim.
Amar rav pappa: hakkol modim befesach, shemmanniach perusa betoch shelema uvotzea. may tama? — "lechem oni" ketiv.
Amar rabbi abba uveshabbat chayyayv adam livtzoa al shete chikkarot. may tama? — "lechem mishne" ketiv.

Amar rav ashe: chazena leh lerav kahana denaket tarte uvatza chada. rabbi zera hava batza akkolla sheruta. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: veha ka mitchaze keraavtanuta. amar [leh]: kevan dechol yoma la kaaved hachi, vehaiddana ka aved — la mitchaze keraavtanuta.
Rav amme verav assi ki hava mitreme lehu rifta deeruva mevarchin aleh "hammotzi lechem min haaretz". amri: hoil veitavid beh mitzva chada, naaved beh mitzva achariti.

a: Amar rav: "tol baruch, tol baruch" — eno tzarich levarech. "have melach" "have liftan" — tzarich levarech. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu "haviu melach" "haviu liftan" name eno tzarich levarech, "gabbel letore, gabbel letore" tzarich levarech. verav sheshet amar: afillu "gabbel letore" name eno tzarich levarech, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: asur laadam sheyyochal kodem sheyyitten maachol livhemto, shenneemar: "venatatti esev besadcha livhemtecha" vahadar "veachalta vesavata".

Amar rava bar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyyay: en habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyaviu melach o liftan lifne kol echad veechad. rava bar shemuel ikkela leve resh galuta, appiku leh rifta, uvetza lehedya. amaru leh: hadar mar mishshemateh? amar lehu: let den tzerich beshash.

Veamar rava bar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyyay: en me raglayim kalim ella bishiva. amar rav kahana: uveafar tichuach, afillu baamida. vei lekka afar tichuach, yaamod bemakom gavoah veyashtin limkom midron.

Veamar rava bar shemuel mishshemeh derabbi chiyyay achar kol achilatcha echol melach, veachar kol shetiyyaytcha shete mayim, vei atta nizzok. tanya name hachi: achar kol achilatcha echol melach, veachar kol shetiyyaytcha shete mayim, vei atta nizzok. tanya iddach: achal kol maachol velo achal melach, shata kol mashkin velo shata mayim, bayyom — yidag min reach happe, uvallayla  — yidag mippene askara.
Tanu rabbanan: hammakpe achilato bemayim, eno ba lide choli meayim. vechamma? amar rav chisda: kiton lefat.
Amar rav mari amar rabbi yochanan: haragil baadashim achat lishloshim yom monea askara mittoch beto. aval kol yoma — la. may tama? — mishshum dekashe lereach happe.
Veamar rav mari amar rabbi yochanan: haragil bechardal achat lishloshim yom — monea cholaim mittoch beto. aval kol yoma — la, may tama? — mishshum dekashe lechulesha delibba.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: haragil bedagim ketannim — eno ba lide choli meayim. velo od, ella sheddagim ketannim mafrin umarbin umavrin kol gufo shel adam.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: haragil beketzach eno ba lide keev lev. metivi: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ketzach — echad mishshishshim sammane hammavet hu, vehayyashen lemizrach gorno — damo berosho. la kashya: ha berecho, ha betamo. immeh derabbi yirmeya afya leh rifta, umedabbeka leh umekallefa leh.

Rabbi yehuda omer "bore mine deshaim". amar rabbi zera, veittema rabbi chinnana bar pappa: en halacha kerabbi yehuda. veamar rabbi zera veittema rabbi chinnana bar pappa: may tama derabbi yehuda — amar kera "baruch Adonai yom yom". vechi bayyom mevarchin oto, uvallayla en mevarchin oto? ella lomar lach: kol yom vayom ten lo meen birchotav, hacha name kol min umin ten lo meen birchotav.

Veamar rabbi zera veittema rabbi chinnana bar pappa: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vadam — keli rekan machazik, male eno machazik. aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno chen, male machazik, rekan eno machazik. shenneemar: "vayyomer im shamoa tishma", im shamoa — tishma, veim lav — lo tishma. davar acher: im shamoa — bayyashan, tishma — bechadash. veim yifne levavcha — shuv lo tishma.
Mishna berach al perot hailan "bore peri haadama" — yatza. veal perot haaretz "bore peri haetz" — lo yatza. veal kullam, im amar "shehakkol nihye bidvaro" — yatza.
Gemara man tanna deikkar ilan ara hi?! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: rabbi yehuda hi, ditnan: yavesh hammayan veniktzatz hailan — mevi veeno kore. rabbi yehuda omer: mevi vekore.

Al perot haaretz vechulei. peshita! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda, deamar chitta min ilan hi. detanya: ilan sheachal mimmennu adam harishon, rabbi meir omer: gefen haya, sheen lecha davar shemmevi yelala al haadam ella yayin, shenneemar: "vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar". rabbi nechemya omer: teena hayta, shebbaddavar shennitkalkelu bo nittakkenu, shenneemar: "vayyitperu ale teena". rabbi yehuda omer: chitta hayta, sheen hattinok yodea likrot "abba" veimma" ad sheyyitom taam dagan.

Salka datach amena, hoil veamar rabbi yehuda chitta min ilan hi, livarech aleh "bore peri haetz". ka mashma lan, hecha mevarchinan bore peri haetz — hecha dechi shaklat leh lefere iteh ligvoza, vahadar mappek,
b: Aval hecha dechi shaklat leh lefere leteh ligvoza dahadar mappek, la mevarchinan aleh "bore peri haetz" ella "bore peri haadama".
Veal kullan im amar "shehakkol" vechulei. ittemar. rav huna amar: chutz min happat umin hayyayin. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu pat veyayin.

Nema ketannae: raa pat veamar: "kamma naa pat zo, baruch hammakom shebberaah" — yatza. raa teena veamar "kamma naa teena zo, baruch hammakom shebberaah" — yatza, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim bivrachot — lo yatza yede chovato. nema rav huna deamar kerabbi yose, verabbi yochanan deamar kerabbi meir?!
Amar lach rav huna: ana daamari afillu lerabbi meir, ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, ella hecha deka madkar shemeh defat, aval hecha dela ka madkar shemeh defat afillu rabbi meir mode.

Verabbi yochanan amar lach: ana daamari afillu lerabbi yose, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam ella mishshum dekaamar beracha dela takkinu rabbanan, aval amar "shehakkol nihye bidvaro" detakkinu rabbanan, afillu rabbi yose mode.
Binyamin raaya kerach rifta, vaamar: "berich mareh dehay pitta". amar rav: yatza. vehaamar rav: kol beracha sheen bah hazekarat hashshem enah beracha! deamar: "berich rachamana mareh dehay pitta".
Veha baenan shalosh berachot? may "yatza" dekaamar rav — name yatza yede beracha rishona.
May kamashma lan? af al gav daamarah bilshon chol.

Tenena: veellu neemarim bechol leshon: parashat sota, vidduy maaser, keriat shema, utefilla, uvirkat hammazon. itzterich: salka datach amena, hane mille daamarah bilshon chol ki hechi detakkinu rabbanan bilshon kodesh, aval lo amarah bilshon chol ki hechi detakkinu rabbanan bilshon kodesh, ema la. ka mashma lan.

Gufa. amar rav: kol beracha sheen bah hazekarat hashshem — enah beracha. verabbi yochanan amar: kol beracha sheen bah malchut enah beracha. amar abbaye: kevoteh derav mistabbera, detanya: "lo avarti mimmitzvotecha velo shachachti": lo avarti — millevarechcha, velo shachachti — millehazkir shimcha alav. veillu malchut la katane.
Verabbi yochanan tane: "velo shachachti" — millehazkir shimcha umalchutecha alav.

Mishna veal davar sheen giddulo min haaretz omer "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". al hachometz veal hannovlot veal haggovay, omer "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". rabbi yehuda omer: kol shehu min kelala en mevarchin alav.
Hayu lefanav minin harebe, rabbi yehuda omer: im yesh benehen min shiva — alav hu mevarech. vachachamim omrim: mevarech al eze mehen sheyyirtze.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: al davar sheen giddulo min haaretz, kegon besar behemot chayyot veofot vedagim omer "shehakkol nihye bidvaro". al hechalav veal habbetzim veal haggevina omer "shehakkol". al happat sheippesha, veal hayyayin shehikrim, veal hattavshil sheibber tzurato omer "shehakkol". al hammelach veal hazzamit veal kemehin ufitriyyot omer "shehakkol". lememra dichmehin ufitriyyot lav giddule karka ninhu? vehatanya hannoder mipperot haaretz — asur beferot haaretz, umuttar bichmehin ufitriyyot, veim amar "kol giddule karka alay" — asur af bichmehin ufitriyyot.
Amar abbaye: mirba ravu meara, menak la yanki meara.
Veha "al davar sheen giddulo min haaretz" katane! teni: al davar sheen yonek min haaretz.
Veal hannovlot: may novlot? rabbi zera verabbi ila. chad amar: bushele chamra. vechad amar: tamre dezika.
Tenan, rabbi yehuda omer: kol shehu min kelala en mevarchin alav. bishlama leman deamar bushele chamra, hayeynu dekare leh "min kelala", ella leman deamar tamre dezika — may min kelala?
Ashsheara.
Ikka deamri: bishlama leman deamar bushele chamra, hayeynu dimvarchinan alayyhu "shehakkol". ella leman deamar tamre dezika, "shehakkol"?! "bore peri haetz" mibbee leh levaroche!

Ella, benovlot setama kulle alma la peligi devushele chamra ninhu. ki peligi benovlot temara. ditnan: hakkallin shebbaddemay: hashshitin, veharimmin, vehauzeradin, benot shuach, uvenot shikma, vegufenin, venitzpa, venovlot temara.

Shitin, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: min teenim. rimmin — kande. hauzeradin — tuleshe. benot shuach, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: teene chivvarata. benot shikma, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: duvele. gufenin — shilhe gufene. nitzpa — pircha. novlot temara — rabbi ila verabbi zera, chad amar: bushele chamra, vechad amar: tamre dezika.
Bishlama leman deamar bushele chamra — hayeynu dekatane hakkallin shebbaddemay sefekan hu defatur, ha vaddaan — chayyayv. ella leman deamar tamre dezika — vaddaan chayyayv?! hefkera ninhu!
Hacha bemay askinan — sheasaan goren. deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: halleket vehashshichcha vehappea sheasaan goren — hukebu lemaaser.
Ikka deamri:

a: Bishlama leman deamar tamre dezika, hayeynu dehacha kare la "novlot" setama, vehatam kare la "temara", ella leman deamar bushele chamra, nitne idde veidde "novlot temara", o idde veidde "novlot" setama. kashya.

Hayu lefanav minin harebe vechulei. amar ulla: machaloket beshebbirchotehen shavot, derabbi yehuda savar min shiva adif, verabbanan savri min chaviv adif. aval besheen birchotehen shavot — divre hakkol mevarech al ze, vechozer umevarech al ze.
Metivi: hayu lefanav tzenon vezayit — mevarech al hatztzenon ufoter et hazzayit! hacha bemay askinan — keshehatztzenon ikkar.

I hachi, ema sefa: rabbi yehuda omer mevarech al hazzayit, shehazzayit mimmin shiva. let leh lerabbi yehuda, ha ditnan: kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela — mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela? vechi tema: hachi name delet leh, vehatanya: rabbi yehuda omer: im mechamat tzenon ba hazzayit — mevarech al hatztzenon ufoter et hazzayit.

Leolam bitznon ikkar askinan, vechi peligi rabbi yehuda verabbanan — bemilleta achariti peligi, vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: hayu lefanav tzenon vezayit — mevarech al hatztzenon ufoter et hazzayit. bamme devarim amurim — keshehatztzenon ikkar, aval en hatztzenon ikkar — divre hakkol mevarech al ze vechozer umevarech al ze. ushene minin bealma shebbirchotehen shavot — mevarech al eze mehen sheyyirtze. rabbi yehuda omer: mevarech al hazzayit, shehazzayit mimmin shiva.

Peligi ba rabbi amme verabbi yitzchak nappacha. chad amar: machaloket beshebbirchotehen shavot, derabbi yehuda savar min shiva adif, verabbanan savri min chaviv adif. aval besheen birchotehen shavot — divre hakkol mevarech al ze vechozer umevarech al ze. vechad amar: af besheen birchotehen shavot name machaloket.
Bishlama leman deamar beshebbirchotehen shavot machaloket — shappir, ella leman deamar besheen birchotehen shavot peligi, bemay peligi! amar rabbi yirmeya: lehakedim.
Deamar rav yosef veittema rabbi yitzchak: kol hammukedam befasuk ze, mukedam livracha, shenneemar: "eretz chitta useora vegefen uteena verimmon eretz zet shemen udevash".
Ufeliga derabbi chanan. deamar rabbi chanan: kol happasuk kullo leshiurin neemar.

"Chitta", ditnan: hannichnas labbayit hamenugga, vechelav al ketefav, vesandalav vetabbeotav beyadav — hu vahen temein miyyad. haya lavush kelav, vesandalav beraglav, vetabbeotav beetzbeotav — hu tame miyyad, vehen tehorin ad sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras. pat chittin velo pat seorin, mesev veochlan beliftan.
"Seora", ditnan: etzem kisora metamme bemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme beohel.
"Gefen", kede reviit yayin lenazir. "teena", kigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat. "rimmon", keditnan: kol kele baale vattim
b: Shiuran kerimmonim.
"Eretz zet shemen", amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: eretz shekkol shiureha kezetim. kol shiureha salka datach?! veha ikka hanach daamaran! ella eretz sherov shiureha kezetim.
"Devash", kechotevet haggassa beyom hakkippurim. veidach — hane shiurin behedya mi ketivi? ella midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.

Rav chisda verav hamenuna havo yatvi bisodta. ayyto lekammayyhu tamre verimmone. shekal rav hamenuna, barech attamre beresha. amar leh rav chisda: la savar la mar leha deamar rav yosef, veittema rabbi yitzchak: kol hammukedam befasuk ze kodem livracha?
Amar leh: ze sheni leeretz", veze chamishi leeretz". amar leh: man yahev lan nigre defarzela uneshammeinnach.

Ittemar: heviu lifnehem teenim vaanavim betoch hasseuda, amar rav huna: teunim beracha lifnehem veen teunim beracha leacharehem. vechen amar rav nachman: teunim beracha lifnehem veen teunim beracha leacharehem. verav sheshet amar: teunin beracha ben lifnehem ben leacharehem. sheen lecha davar shettaun beracha lefanav veen taun beracha leacharav ella pat habbaa bechisanin bilvad. ufeliga derabbi chiyyay deamar rabbi chiyyay: pat poteret kol mine maachol, veyayin poter kol mine mashkim.

Amar rav pappa: hilcheta devarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda betoch hasseuda — en teunim beracha lo lifnehem velo leacharehem. veshello mechamat hasseuda betoch hasseuda — teunim beracha lifnehem veen teunim beracha leacharehem. leachar hasseuda — teunim beracha ben lifnehem ben leacharehem.

Shaalu et ben zoma: mippene ma amru devarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda betoch hasseuda enam teunim beracha lo lifnehem velo leacharehem? amar lahem: hoil ufat potartan. i hachi, yayin name niftereh pat! shane yayin
